import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { apiClient } from "../../config/api";
import type { TemplateListResponse } from "../../designer/types";
import "./templates.css";

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  draft: "草稿",
  published: "已发布",
  archived: "已归档",
};

export const TemplatesPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [data, setData] = useState<TemplateListResponse | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: "1", pageSize: "50" });
    if (search.trim()) params.set("search", search.trim());
    apiClient<TemplateListResponse>(`/templates?${params.toString()}`)
      .then(setData)
      .catch((err: unknown) =>
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "加载失败"),
      )
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [search]);

  return (
    <div className="templates">
      <div className="templates-toolbar">
        <div className="templates-search">
          <input
            value={search}
            placeholder="搜索模板名称"
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate("/designer/create")}>
          + 新建模板
        </button>
      </div>

      {error ? (
        <p className="templates-error">加载模板失败：{error}</p>
      ) : loading ? (
        <p className="templates-empty">加载中…</p>
      ) : !data || data.items.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="templates-empty">暂无模板，点击“新建模板”开始</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <table className="templates-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>名称</th>
                <th>分类</th>
                <th>状态</th>
                <th>锁定者</th>
                <th>版本</th>
                <th>更新时间</th>
                <th></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.items.map((tpl) => (
                <tr key={tpl.id}>
                  <td className="tpl-name">{tpl.name}</td>
                  <td>{tpl.category ?? "—"}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span className={`tpl-status tpl-status--${tpl.status}`}>
                      {STATUS_LABEL[tpl.status] ?? tpl.status}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>{tpl.locked_by_name ?? (tpl.locked_by ? "—" : "未锁定")}</td>
                  <td>v{tpl.version}</td>
                  <td>{formatDate(tpl.updated_at)}</td>
                  <td>
                    <Link to={`/designer/templates/${tpl.id}`}>进入设计</Link>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <p className="templates-total">共 {data.total} 个模板</p>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime())
    ? iso
    : d.toLocaleString("zh-CN", { hour12: false });
}

```

import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import type { FieldSchema } from "form-engine-core";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { PropertyPanel } from "./PropertyPanel";
import { createEmptySchema } from "./schemaModel";

const selectField: FieldSchema = {
  id: "fld-1",
  type: "select",
  label: "部门",
  required: false,
  options: [
    { label: "选项一", value: "option1" },
    { label: "选项二", value: "option2" },
  ],
};

const textField: FieldSchema = {
  id: "fld-2",
  type: "text",
  label: "姓名",
  required: false,
};

describe("PropertyPanel", () => {
  it("shows a hint when no field is selected", () => {
    render(
      <PropertyPanel
        schema={createEmptySchema()}
        selected={null}
        onChangeField={vi.fn()}
      />,
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("请选择一个字段以编辑属性")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("edits options via the options editor", async () => {
    const onChangeField = vi.fn();
    render(
      <PropertyPanel
        schema={createEmptySchema()}
        selected={{ sectionId: "sec-1", field: selectField }}
        onChangeField={onChangeField}
      />,
    );

    expect(screen.getByLabelText("选项1标签")).toHaveValue("选项一");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText("+ 添加选项"));

    expect(onChangeField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sec-1", "fld-1", {
      options: [
        { label: "选项一", value: "option1" },
        { label: "选项二", value: "option2" },
        { label: "新选项", value: "option3" },
      ],
    });
  });

  it("writes text validation rules via setRule", async () => {
    const onChangeField = vi.fn();
    render(
      <PropertyPanel
        schema={createEmptySchema()}
        selected={{ sectionId: "sec-1", field: textField }}
        onChangeField={onChangeField}
      />,
    );

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText("最小长度"), "5");
    expect(onChangeField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sec-1", "fld-2", {
      validation: {
        rules: [{ type: "minLength", value: 5 }],
      },
    });
  });

  it("switches tabs to approval chain and preview", async () => {
    render(
      <PropertyPanel
        schema={createEmptySchema()}
        selected={null}
        onChangeField={vi.fn()}
      />,
    );

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "审批链" }));
    expect(screen.getByText(/无审批链/)).toBeInTheDocument();

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "预览" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("暂无字段可预览")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

```

import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { DesignCanvas } from "./DesignCanvas";
import type { DesignerSchema } from "./schemaModel";

const schema: DesignerSchema = {
  schemaVersion: "1.0.0",
  sections: [
    {
      id: "sec-1",
      title: "基础信息",
      fields: [
        { id: "fld-1", type: "text", label: "姓名", required: false },
        { id: "fld-2", type: "select", label: "部门", required: false },
      ],
    },
  ],
};

function renderCanvas(overrides: Partial<Parameters<typeof DesignCanvas>[0]> = {}) {
  const props = {
    schema,
    selectedFieldId: null,
    onDropField: vi.fn(),
    onSelectField: vi.fn(),
    onMoveField: vi.fn(),
    onReorderField: vi.fn(),
    onRemoveField: vi.fn(),
    onAddSection: vi.fn(),
    onUpdateSectionTitle: vi.fn(),
    ...overrides,
  };
  render(<DesignCanvas {...props} />);
  return props;
}

describe("DesignCanvas", () => {
  it("renders section title, field labels and type names", () => {
    renderCanvas();
    expect(screen.getByDisplayValue("基础信息")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("姓名")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("部门")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getAllByText("单行文本")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("selects a field on click", async () => {
    const { onSelectField } = renderCanvas();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText("姓名"));
    expect(onSelectField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("fld-1");
  });

  it("moves a field down via the down button", async () => {
    const { onMoveField } = renderCanvas();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByLabelText("下移")[0]);
    expect(onMoveField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sec-1", "fld-1", 1);
  });

  it("removes a field", async () => {
    const { onRemoveField } = renderCanvas();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByLabelText("删除字段")[0]);
    expect(onRemoveField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sec-1", "fld-1");
  });

  it("adds a section", async () => {
    const { onAddSection } = renderCanvas();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText("+ 添加章节"));
    expect(onAddSection).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

```

Two-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:

- **Standards** — does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?
- **Spec** — does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?

Both axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.

The issue tracker should have been provided to you — run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` if `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing.

## Process

### 1. Pin the fixed point

Whatever the user said is the fixed point — a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc. If they didn't specify one, ask for it.

Capture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.

Before going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here — not inside two parallel sub-agents.

### 2. Identify the spec source

Look for the originating spec, in this order:

1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.) — fetch via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.
2. A path the user passed as an argument.
3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.
4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report "no spec available".

### 3. Identify the standards sources

Anything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

On top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below — a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:

- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.
- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic ("possible Feature Envy"), never a hard violation — and, like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.

Each smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:

- **Mysterious Name** — a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.
- **Duplicated Code** — the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.
- **Feature Envy** — a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.
- **Data Clumps** — the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.
- **Primitive Obsession** — a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.
- **Repeated Switches** — the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.
- **Shotgun Surgery** — one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.
- **Divergent Change** — one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.
- **Speculative Generality** — abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.
- **Message Chains** — long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.
- **Middle Man** — a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.
- **Refused Bequest** — a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.

### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel

**Standards sub-agent prompt** — include:

- The full diff command and commit list.
- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full — the sub-agent has no other access to it.
- The brief: "Report — per file/hunk where relevant — (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls — documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words."

**Spec sub-agent prompt** — include:

- The diff command and commit list.
- The path or fetched contents of the spec.
- The brief: "Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words."

If the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.

### 5. Aggregate

Present the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings — the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).

End with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes — that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.

## Why two axes

A change can pass one axis and fail the other:

- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**
- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**

Reporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.

## Smell baseline (applies regardless of repo docs; each is a labelled heuristic, never a hard violation)
- **Mysterious Name** — a function/variable/type name that doesn't reveal what it does. → rename.
- **Duplicated Code** — same logic shape appears in more than one hunk/file. → extract shared shape.
- **Feature Envy** — a method reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method.
- **Data Clumps** — same few fields/params keep travelling together. → bundle into a type.
- **Primitive Obsession** — a primitive/string stands in for a domain concept deserving its own type. → give it a type.
- **Repeated Switches** — same switch/if-cascade on the same type recurs. → polymorphism or a shared map.
- **Shotgun Surgery** — one logical change forces scattered edits across many files. → gather into one module.
- **Divergent Change** — one file edited for several unrelated reasons. → split.
- **Speculative Generality** — abstraction/params/hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete/inline.
- **Message Chains** — long `a.b().c().d()` navigation. → hide behind one method.
- **Middle Man** — a class/function that mostly delegates onward. → cut it.
- **Refused Bequest** — subclass/implementer ignoring most of what it inherits. → use composition.

Two rules bind the baseline: (1) a documented repo standard overrides a smell it endorses; (2) skip anything tooling already enforces (e.g. tsc/lint formatting).

## Report
Report — per file/hunk where relevant — (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard (cite the file + rule); and (b) any baseline smell (name it + quote the hunk). Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.

1	# 动态表单引擎 — 领域词汇表
2	
3	> 本文档定义系统中的核心术语。它是语义的唯一权威来源——当代码、设计文档、对话中使用这些词时，必须与此处定义一致。
4	
5	---
6	
7	## 核心实体
8	
9	### FormTemplate（表单模板）
10	
11	设计者创建的表单定义。包含表单结构（Schema）、审批链配置、分类、版本号。模板是配置的**单一事实来源**，引擎将其翻译为 UI 和行为。
12	
13	**状态**：`draft`（编辑中）→ `published`（已发布，用户可填写）→ `archived`（已归档，不可新建实例）
14	
15	> 模板**不存在审批流程**。质量保障通过环境晋升实现：UAT 充分测试 → PROD 迁移。参见 `docs/requirement-spec-form-engine.md` v1.1 第 3 节。
16	
17	### FormInstance（表单实例）
18	
19	用户提交表单时创建的运行时记录。绑定提交时刻的模板快照（`template_snapshot`），后续模板变更不影响已有实例。
20	
21	**状态**：`draft` → `submitted` → `in_approval` → `approved` | `rejected` | `returned` | `withdrawn`
22	
23	### ApprovalRecord（审批记录）
24	
25	审批链上一个审批节点的执行记录。实例提交时创建第一条，审批流转时逐节点创建。
26	
27	**动作**：`pending` → `approved` | `rejected` | `returned` | `transferred`
28	
29	### Draft（草稿）
30	
31	用户未完成填写的中间状态。与 Instance 的 `draft` 状态不同：Draft 是独立实体，`field_values` 为部分填写内容。草稿保留 2 年，超期清除。
32	
33	**版本不匹配**：打开草稿时若模板已更新，基于 fieldId 尽力映射——匹配的值迁移，不匹配的移入 `_orphaned` 对象。界面顶部黄色提示。
34	
35	**自动保存**：onBlur + 30s 定时兜底 + dirty 检测。无变更时不请求。
36	
37	### Notification（通知）
38	
39	关键业务事件触发的消息。**at-most-once 实时投递**（SSE push），**at-least-once 持久化**（数据库 INSERT）。两者走不同的可靠路径。
40	
41	**渠道适配器**：投递层使用适配器模式——MVP 仅 `InAppChannel`。后续可插拔 Email、企微等渠道，不影响核心逻辑。
42	
43	### OrgDataSource（组织架构数据源）
44	
45	用户数据和审批人解析的统一接口。系统**只读消费**，不维护部门树。MVP 实现为静态 JSON 导入，后续可替换为企业微信/飞书/LDAP。
46	
47	### SchemaVersion（Schema 格式版本）
48	
49	JSONB Schema 根部的 `schemaVersion` 字段（语义版本号，如 `"1.0.0"`）。引擎按版本解释——未知版本拒绝渲染。不同于 `FormTemplate.version`（并发控制，INT）。版本兼容策略：同主版本允许导入，跨主版本拒绝。
50	
51	---
52	
53	## 角色与门户
54	
55	### 角色（Role）
56	
57	系统内**固定的五种角色**，决定用户登录后进入哪个门户、拥有哪些能力。角色由系统预定义（MVP 不动态创建）。
58	
59	枚举：`模板设计者`、`表单填写者`、`审批人`、`系统管理员`、`运维人员`。
60	
61	_Avoid_: 用户组、权限组、岗位
62	
63	### 门户（Portal）
64	
65	按角色分割的独立入口区域。用户登录后按角色路由到对应门户，不同角色看到完全不同的导航结构。
66	
67	五个门户：`/designer`（模板设计者）、`/filler`（表单填写者）、`/approver`（审批人）、`/admin`（系统管理员）、`/ops`（运维人员）。
68	
69	_Avoid_: 后台、控制台、管理端
70	
71	---
72	
73	## 核心操作
74	
75	### 表单提交（Submit）
76	
77	原子操作：在**同一数据库事务**中创建 Instance + 快照 Template + ApprovalRecord。事务后异步投递 Notification + SSE push。
78	
79	### 审批操作（Approve / Reject / Return / Transfer）
80	
81	对当前审批节点的决策。需要 **`Idempotency-Key`**（24 小时窗口）。使用乐观锁（`FormInstance.version`）防止竞态。
82	
83	### 撤回（Withdraw）
84	
85	提交人在审批人未处理时将 Instance 恢复为 `draft`。与审批操作存在竞态窗口，通过乐观锁解决。
86	
87	### 签出 / 签入（Checkout / Checkin）
88	
89	模板编辑的独占锁机制。同一时间仅一人可编辑。管理员可强制解锁。
90	
91	### 条件编辑器（Condition Editor）
92	
93	MVP 仅支持单层 AND 条件（平铺条件行，不支持 OR 和嵌套）。完整嵌套 AND/OR AST 编辑器推迟至 Phase 2。条件数据格式有兼容升级路径——旧格式自动包装为 AndCondition 节点。
94	
95	### 子表单（Subform）
96	
97	可增删行的表格/结构化数据。最大嵌套深度 2 层（主表单 → 子表单 → 孙表单）。子表单内字段支持条件联动和验证。
98	
99	---
100	
101	## 并发控制
102	
103	### 乐观锁（Optimistic Locking）
104	
105	`FormInstance` 和 `FormTemplate` 使用 `version` 列（整数，从 1 开始）。UPDATE 时 WHERE 条件包含 `version = :expected`，并 `SET version = version + 1`。0 rows affected → 冲突 → 返回 409。
106	
107	适用于：撤回 vs 审批竞态、重复提交、并发保存。
108	
109	### 幂等键（Idempotency Key）
110	
111	写操作客户端生成唯一 key，服务端存储 key → response。24 小时后可回收。重复请求返回缓存结果，不重复执行。
112	
113	---
114	
115	## 事务
116	
117	### 事务边界（Transaction Boundary）
118	
119	数据库事务保护 Instance + Snapshot + ApprovalRecord 的原子写入。事务外（异步）：Notification 持久化 + SSE push。审批人解析在事务内执行——失败回滚整个提交。
120	
121	---
122

126	- [Sitemap](docs/sitemap-form-engine.md) —— 门户路由模型（5 角色门户）

```text
1	# 实施规格说明书：动态表单引擎 MVP
2	
3	> 版本：v1.0
4	> 日期：2026-08-12
5	> 状态：就绪（ready-for-agent）
6	> 来源：基于 [设计规格 v1.2](design-spec-form-engine.md) + 6 项 ADR + C1-C14 整改决策
7	
8	---
9	
10	## Problem Statement
11	
12	企业业务系统中，每个表单需要独立开发前端代码。中等复杂度表单开发 2-3 天，需求变更时修改成本高，各表单样式和交互难以统一。业务人员无技术能力自主创建表单，完全依赖开发团队。
13	
14	本系统解决的核心问题：**让业务人员零代码创建表单、配置审批流程；员工在统一界面完成填写与审批追踪。**
15	
16	目标规模：50 并发在线填写者，日均 100 次提交。
17	
18	---
19	
20	## Solution
21	
22	一个**配置驱动的动态表单引擎**，采用 Schema → Engine → Component 三层架构：
23	
24	```
25	表单设计者编排 Schema（JSON 配置）
26	        ↓
27	引擎解析 Schema，驱动渲染、验证、联动、审批流转
28	        ↓
29	填写者看到统一 UI，审批人通过内置工作流处理
30	```
31	
32	**MVP 技术栈**：React 18 + Vite（前端），Express + PostgreSQL + JSONB（后端），SSE（实时通知），Docker Compose 部署。
33	
34	---
35	
36	## User Stories
37	
38	### 表单设计者
39	
40	1. As a 表单设计者, I want to 创建空白表单模板并设置名称、描述和分类, so that 建立表单元数据基础。
41	2. As a 表单设计者, I want to 从组件面板拖拽字段到画布并自由调整顺序, so that 可视化编排表单结构。
42	3. As a 表单设计者, I want to 选中字段后在属性面板配置标签、提示文本、默认值和验证规则, so that 精确控制字段行为。
43	4. As a 表单设计者, I want to 创建章节（字段分组）并支持折叠/展开, so that 组织复杂表单的布局层次。
44	5. As a 表单设计者, I want to 为字段配置单层 AND 显示条件（如"设备类型=研发 → 显示某字段"）, so that 根据上下文动态控制表单。
45	6. As a 表单设计者, I want to 在设计器右侧面板实时预览填写态效果, so that 即时验证设计效果。
46	7. As a 表单设计者, I want to 签出表单模板获得独占编辑权，完成后签入, so that 防止多人并发编辑冲突。
47	8. As a 表单设计者, I want to 将表单配置导出为可迁移文件并导入到其他环境, so that 通过 DEV→SIT→UAT→PROD 逐级验证后上线。
48	9. As a 表单设计者, I want to 为表单配置多级审批链（组织架构/角色/指定人员）, so that 提交后自动触发审批流转。
49	
50	### 表单填写者
51	
52	10. As a 填写者, I want to 浏览我有权限的已发布表单列表并支持搜索和分类筛选, so that 快速找到目标表单。
53	11. As a 填写者, I want to 按照设计者编排的结构依次填写字段, so that 完成信息录入。
54	12. As a 填写者, I want to 填写时实时看到字段验证反馈（必填未填、格式不符）, so that 提交前修正错误。
55	13. As a 填写者, I want to 将未完成的表单保存为草稿并稍后恢复继续填写, so that 不丢失已输入内容。
56	14. As a 填写者, I want to 草稿自动保存（失焦 + 30s 兜底）, so that 即使忘记手动保存数据也不丢失。
57	15. As a 填写者, I want to 打开草稿时被告知模板是否已更新且已有数据尽力匹配, so that 知道字段变化且数据不丢失。
58	16. As a 填写者, I want to 提交表单后在同一界面看到审批链状态（各级审批人、当前进度）, so that 了解流转进展。
59	17. As a 填写者, I want to 在审批人未处理时撤回已提交的表单, so that 修正错误后重新提交。
60	18. As a 填写者, I want to 在移动端浏览器中完整完成填写、提交和进度查看, so that 在手机和平板上工作。
61	
62	### 审批人
63	
64	19. As a 审批人, I want to 收到新审批请求的通知并一键进入审批界面, so that 及时处理。
65	20. As a 审批人, I want to 在审批界面同时看到完整表单内容（只读）和审批链状态, so that 充分了解上下文后决策。
66	21. As a 审批人, I want to 点击"同意"使审批流转至下一级或完成, so that 推进流程。
67	22. As a 审批人, I want to 点击"拒绝"并填写原因使流程终止, so that 否决不合规的提交。
68	23. As a 审批人, I want to 将表单退回给提交人要求修改, so that 补正不完整或错误信息。
69	24. As a 审批人, I want to 将审批转交给另一位指定人员, so that 在自身无法处理时分流。
70	25. As a 审批人, I want to 看到审批链上所有参与者的审批状态和意见, so that 了解完整审批上下文。
71	
72	### 数据管理者
73	
74	26. As a 被授权用户, I want to 按表单类型查看所有已提交的数据列表并支持筛选, so that 检索历史记录。
75	27. As a 被授权用户, I want to 查看单条提交的完整表单内容和审批历史, so that 了解详情。
76	28. As a 被授权用户, I want to 将筛选数据导出为 Excel, so that 用于离线分析或对接其他系统。
77	29. As a 被授权用户, I want to 查看按表单类型的提交量统计, so that 了解各表单使用情况。
78	
79	### 系统管理员
80	
81	30. As a 管理员, I want to 创建自定义角色并分配能力, so that 权限模型匹配组织实际职能。
82	31. As a 管理员, I want to 将角色分配给用户, so that 用户获得对应操作权限。
83	32. As a 管理员, I want to 在特殊情况下强制签入被锁定的模板, so that 解除异常锁定。
84	
85	---
86	
87	## Seams
88	
89	测试应围绕以下模块边界（从内到外）：
90	
91	### 一级 Seam：FormEngine 纯逻辑（推荐主要测试点）
92	
93	这些模块零外部依赖——无 DOM、无数据库、无网络。纯函数/状态机，单元测试成本最低、价值最高：
94	
95	- **SchemaParser**：Raw JSON → ParsedSchema IR。校验结构合法性、字段类型可识别、审批链完整性、子表单嵌套深度 ≤ 2。
96	- **ValidationEngine**：`validateField(fieldSchema, value) → FieldError[]`、`validateAll(parsedSchema, values) → AllErrors`。覆盖每种验证规则独立执行和组合执行。
97	- **ConditionEvaluator**：`evaluate(conditionNode, allValues) → boolean`。MVP 仅 AND 组合；每种运算符全覆盖。
98	- **VisibilityEngine**：基于当前 values 计算 fields/sections 可见性。单字段联动、章节级联动、依赖链重算。
99	- **FormStateManager**：reducer——`dispatch(action) → new State`。setValue 触发联动+验证；touched 追踪；dirty 标记。
100	- **ApprovalStateMachine**：`transition(currentState, action) → newState`。覆盖 7 个状态、6 种转换、合法与非法路径。基于属性测试生成随机序列验证不变量。
101	- **ApprovalResolver**：`resolveApprover(rule, submitter) → approver`。3 种规则类型；解析失败返回 null。
102	
103	### 二级 Seam：API 端点
104	
105	Express route handler——HTTP 请求 → 响应。可用 supertest + 测试数据库：
106	
107	- 模板 CRUD、签出/签入、发布、导出/导入
108	- 实例提交（原子事务校验、模板状态校验）、草稿保存/恢复、撤回
109	- 审批操作（幂等、乐观锁冲突 409、状态机守卫）
110	- 通知列表、标记已读
111	
112	### 三级 Seam：组件渲染
113	
114	React Testing Library + 模拟 FormEngine：
115	
116	- 字段组件按 FieldComponentProps 契约正确渲染
117	- 表单提交按钮 disabled 状态、防重点击
118	- 草稿自动保存状态指示器
119	
120	### 端到端
121	
122	4 条关键旅程（Cypress/Playwright）：
123	
124	1. 设计者创建模板 → 拖拽字段 → 配置属性 → 配置审批链 → 发布 → 导出
125	2. 填写者浏览 → 打开表单 → 填写 → 保存草稿 → 恢复草稿 → 提交 → 查看审批进度
126	3. 审批人收到通知 → 查看待审批 → 审批同意/拒绝/退回/转交 → 流程完成
127	4. 移动端浏览器打开 → 表单适配单列 → 填写 → 提交
128	
129	---
130	
131	## Implementation Decisions
132	
133	### 数据完整性
134	
135	**ID-01：混合事务策略**。表单提交和审批操作的核心写入（Instance + Snapshot + ApprovalRecord）在同一个数据库事务中执行。事务提交后异步投递 Notification 持久化和 SSE push。审批人解析在事务内执行，失败回滚整个提交。详见 [ADR-0001](adr/0001-transaction-boundaries.md)。
136	
137	**ID-02：审批接口幂等键**。`approve`、`reject`、`return`、`transfer` 四个接口强制 `Idempotency-Key` Header。24 小时幂等窗口。`submit` 不强制——前端防抖 + 乐观锁兜底。详见 [ADR-0002](adr/0002-idempotency-keys.md)。
138	
139	### 并发控制
140	
141	**ID-03：乐观锁**。`FormInstance` 和 `FormTemplate` 增加 `version` INT 列（从 1 开始）。UPDATE 的 WHERE 条件包含 `version = :expected`，SET `version = version + 1`。0 rows affected → 409 Conflict。撤回与审批竞态、重复提交均通过此机制消除。前端收到 409 后显示明确提示（"该提交已被撤回"）并自动刷新。详见 [ADR-0003](adr/0003-optimistic-locking.md)。
142	
143	### 版本化
144	
145	**ID-04：API 版本前缀**。所有路由使用 `/api/v1/`。前端在统一位置配置 base URL。
146	
147	**ID-05：Schema 格式版本**。每个 JSONB Schema 根部必含 `schemaVersion` 字段（语义版本号，如 `"1.0.0"`）。引擎按版本解释，未知版本拒绝渲染。导出兼容策略：同主版本允许，跨主版本拒绝 + 手动迁移脚本。注意区分 `FormTemplate.version`（并发控制 INT）和 `schema.schemaVersion`（格式版本 string）。详见 [ADR-0005](adr/0005-schema-api-versioning.md)。
148	
149	### 草稿与数据
150	
151	**ID-06：草稿-模板版本不匹配**。打开草稿时比较 `draft.updatedAt` 与 `FormTemplate.updatedAt`。基于 fieldId 尽力映射——匹配的自动迁移，不匹配的移入 `_orphaned` 对象。界面顶部黄色提示条。详见 [ADR-0004](adr/0004-draft-template-version-mismatch.md)。
152	
153	**ID-07：草稿自动保存**。onBlur 触发（dirty 检测）+ 30s 定时兜底。无变更不请求。界面显示"草稿已保存 X 秒前"。
154	
155	**ID-08：提交时校验模板状态**。`POST /api/v1/instances/:id/submit` 必须确认 `template.status === 'published'`，否则拒绝提交。
156	
157	### MVP 范围约束
158	
159	**ID-09：条件编辑器 MVP**。仅支持单层 AND 条件（平铺条件行，不支持 OR 和嵌套分组）。数据格式预留升级路径——Phase 2 时旧格式自动包装为 AndCondition 节点。详见 [ADR-0006](adr/0006-mvp-condition-editor-scope.md)。
160	
161	**ID-10：子表单深度**。最大嵌套 2 层（主表单 → 子表单 → 孙表单）。SchemaParser 校验拒绝更深嵌套。子表单内字段支持联动和验证。
162	
163	**ID-11：模板无审批流程**。模板状态仅 `draft` / `published` / `archived`。设计者可直接发布。质量保障通过 UAT → PROD 环境晋升实现。
164	
165	### 组织架构与通知
166	
167	**ID-12：组织架构只读消费**。系统不维护部门树。通过 `OrgDataSource` 接口抽象（`getUser`、`searchUsers`、`getUserManager`），MVP 实现为静态 JSON 导入。UserPicker 和审批人解析通过该接口获取数据。后续可替换为企业微信/飞书/LDAP。
168	
169	**ID-13：通知渠道适配器**。MVP 仅站内通知（SSE 实时 + 通知中心持久化）。NotificationService 投递层使用适配器模式——`InAppChannel`（默认），后续可插拔 Email、企微等渠道。
170	
171	### 安全
172	
173	**ID-14：CSRF 防护**。`httpOnly` Cookie 存储 JWT + `X-CSRF-Token` Header（值从独立非 httpOnly Cookie 读取）。所有非 GET 请求校验收 Token。
174	
175	**ID-15：速率限制**。Express 中间件 + 内存计数：登录 5/min/IP、文件上传 20/min/用户、提交 10/min/用户、导出 5/hour/用户。
176	
177	**ID-16：文件名消毒**。上传时丢弃原始路径，保留 basename，前加 UUID 前缀。存储路径必须在 `upload_root` 内验证通过。格式：`{upload_dir}/{uuid}_{sanitized_basename}`。
178	
179	### 跨领域决策
180	
181	**ID-17**：单租户（无 `tenant_id`）、仅中文（MVP）、结构化日志（Pino/Winston JSON + traceId）、Docker Compose 部署、进程内事件队列（MVP）、Knex 迁移、JWT 滑动过期（7 天 + `/api/v1/auth/refresh`）、统一错误格式 `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`、偏移量分页（page/pageSize，上限 100）、环境变量 + dotenv。
182	
183	### 错误码
184	
185	```
186	VALIDATION_ERROR          → 422  字段值校验失败
187	VERSION_CONFLICT          → 409  乐观锁冲突
188	IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT      → 409  幂等键重复（不同请求体）
189	TEMPLATE_LOCKED           → 409  模板已被他人签出
190	TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED    → 400  模板未发布或已下线
191	APPROVAL_NOT_PENDING      → 400  审批已处理，无法操作
192	APPROVER_RESOLUTION_FAILED → 500  审批人解析失败
193	SCHEMA_VERSION_UNKNOWN    → 400  Schema 版本不被引擎支持
194	RATE_LIMITED              → 429  触发速率限制
195	```
196	
197	---
198	
199	## Testing Decisions
200	
201	### 什么构成好的测试
202	
203	- 测试**外部行为**，不测试内部实现。验证给定输入 → 输出/副作用，不验证内部调用链。
204	- 一级 Seam 优先——纯逻辑模块用单元测试全覆盖。每个模块的错误路径必须至少和快乐路径一样多的测试分量。
205	- 集成测试覆盖 API 端点 + 数据库交互——重点验证事务边界和并发行为。
206	- E2E 仅覆盖 4 条关键旅程——不做边界用例的 E2E（成本高、运行慢）。
207	
208	### 关键测试场景
209	
210	**单元测试（Engine 模块）**：
211	
212	| 模块 | 必须覆盖 |
213	|------|---------|
214	| SchemaParser | 合法 Schema 解析；缺少必填字段/未知 fieldType/空审批链/嵌套超深的拒绝；子表单深度边界（2 层通过，3 层拒绝） |
215	| ValidationEngine | 每种验证规则独立执行；组合规则执行；跨字段验证（如日期比较）；空值和边界值 |
216	| ConditionEvaluator | 每个运算符全覆盖；AND 短路求值；字段不存在/值为 null 的防御 |
217	| VisibilityEngine | 单字段联动；章节级联动；多字段依赖链；条件从 true→false 时子字段也隐藏 |
218	| FormStateManager | setValue 触发验证和联动；touched 仅在 onBlur 时 true；dirty 标记；reset/restore |
219	| ApprovalStateMachine | 合法转换执行；非法转换拒绝（如 approved→withdraw）；基于属性的测试——生成随机合法/非法序列，验证不变量（终态不可转变、每个状态可到达） |
220	| ApprovalResolver | org_structure/role/specific 三个规则；解析失败返回 null；解析结果正确映射到 User |
221	
222	**集成测试**：
223	
224	- 表单提交：原子写入验证（Instance + Snapshot + ApprovalRecord 要么全有要么全无）
225	- 提交时模板已下线 → 400
226	- 审批操作 + 幂等键：重复请求返回缓存结果
227	- 审批 + 乐观锁：version 不匹配返回 409
228	- 撤回 + 乐观锁：审批人已处理后撤回返回 409
229	- 草稿版本不匹配：打开时检测并正确生成 _orphaned
230	- 文件上传路径穿越：恶意文件名被消毒
231	
232	**审批状态机属性测试（示例）**：
233	
234	```
235	Given 状态机从 DRAFT 开始
236	When  生成随机合法动作序列
237	Then  验证不变量——
238	     - 终态（APPROVED, REJECTED）不可再 transition
239	     - WITHDRAWN 后状态回到 DRAFT
240	     - RETURNED 后重新 SUBMIT 从第一节点开始
241	Given 状态机在任意状态
242	When  生成随机非法动作
243	Then  全部被拒绝，状态不变
244	```
245	
246	### E2E 旅程
247	
248	仅 4 条，不增不减。每条覆盖一个完整的用户角色视角。
249	
250	---
251	
252	## Out of Scope
253	
254	以下明确为 MVP 不做：
255	
256	- **嵌套 AND/OR 条件编辑器**（Phase 2）
257	- **邮件/短信/企业微信通知渠道**（架构预留适配器接口，实现推迟）
258	- **移动端离线填写**（依赖 Service Worker）
259	- **可视化统计仪表板**（仅提供按模板类型计数）
260	- **多租户隔离**（企业内部单租户部署）
261	- **国际化/多语言**（仅中文）
262	- **React Query / 独立缓存层**（MVP 用自定义 hook + fetch）
263	- **Zustand 全局状态**（MVP 统一用 Context + useReducer）
264	- **独立任务队列（Redis/Bull）**（MVP 用进程内事件队列）
265	- **审批意见可见性粒度控制**（MVP 所有参与者可见）
266	- **审批超时自动处理**（人工跟进，无自动超时）
267	- **大于 1000 条的异步 Excel 导出**（MVP 同步导出限 1000 条）

289	### 实施优先级
290	
291	| 阶段 | 内容 |
292	|------|------|
293	| 立即 | 后端：数据库 schema + 迁移 + 事务基础设施 + FormEngine 核心模块（SchemaParser, ValidationEngine, ConditionEvaluator, ApprovalStateMachine） |

# 04 — 模板 API + 表单设计器

**What to build:** 设计者从模板列表创建新模板 → 进入三栏设计器（组件面板 + 画布 + 属性面板/预览）→ 拖拽字段到画布 → 配置属性 → 实时预览 → 签入保存 → 发布。模板可直接发布（无审批流程）。

- 模板 API（全部 /api/v1/ 前缀）：
  - POST /api/v1/templates — 创建模板（自动签出给创建者）
  - GET /api/v1/templates — 列表（?category=&status=&search=&page=&pageSize=）
  - GET /api/v1/templates/:id — 详情（含 schema + approval_chain）
  - PUT /api/v1/templates/:id/schema — 保存 Schema（校验签出锁持有者）
  - POST /api/v1/templates/:id/checkout — 签出（已锁 → 409）
  - POST /api/v1/templates/:id/checkin — 签入（释放锁）
  - POST /api/v1/templates/:id/publish — 发布（draft → published，原子：UPDATE status + 清缓存）
  - POST /api/v1/templates/:id/force-unlock — 强制解锁（管理员）
- 设计器 UI：
  - 三栏 flex 布局：左侧 ComponentPalette（240px）+ 中间 DesignCanvas（flex:1）+ 右侧面板（360px，属性/审批链/预览三个 Tab）
  - 拖拽支持：Palette → Canvas（HTML5 DnD），Canvas 内字段排序（拖拽手柄）
  - 属性面板：按 fieldType 动态渲染配置表单（基本属性 + 验证规则 + 选项编辑器）
  - 预览面板：嵌只读 FormEngine，Schema 变更时 < 1s 同步渲染
  - 签出状态徽标（"编辑中"/"已锁定 - 张三"）
- 集成测试：创建模板 → 签出 → 编辑 → 签入 → 发布全流程；他人签出已锁模板 → 409；强制解锁
```

Also read `CONTEXT.md` for domain terms if needed to judge naming correctness.

```text
1	# ADR-0005：Schema 与 API 版本化策略
2	
3	> 日期：2026-08-12
4	> 状态：已采纳
5	> 关联问题：设计评审 C8（中）、C9（中）、C5 Q-06
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 背景
10	
11	C8 和 C9 同属版本化问题，一并决策。Q-06（配置导出兼容策略）也与 Schema 版本化共享同一个 `schemaVersion` 字段。
12	
13	- **C8**：JSONB Schema 结构一定会演进（新增字段类型、验证规则、条件 AST 格式）。数据库中已有模板是旧格式，引擎如何解释？
14	- **C9**：REST API 目前无版本前缀。API 演进时旧客户端直接崩溃。
15	- **Q-06**：配置导出/导入的版本兼容策略？
16	
17	## 决策
18	
19	### API 版本化（C9）
20	
21	**所有路由使用 `/api/v1/` 前缀**。
22	
23	```
24	原                           → 新
25	POST /api/templates          → POST /api/v1/templates
26	GET  /api/instances/:id      → GET  /api/v1/instances/:id
27	POST /api/approvals/:id/approve → POST /api/v1/approvals/:id/approve
28	...
29	```
30	
31	不做 `/api/latest` 别名——强制显式版本避免客户端隐式依赖未知行为。
32	
33	### Schema 版本化（C8）
34	
35	**每个 JSONB Schema 根部必须包含 `schemaVersion` 字段**（语义版本号，如 `"1.0.0"`）。
36	
37	```json
38	{
39	  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
40	  "sections": [...]
41	}
42	```
43	
44	引擎加载时读取 `schemaVersion`：
45	- **已知版本** → 正常解析
46	- **未知版本** → 拒绝渲染，记录日志，触发告警
47	
48	**不做运行时自动迁移**。系统大版本升级时提供一次性迁移脚本（管理员手动执行），将数据库中所有模板的 Schema JSONB 升级。
49	
50	### 版本号命名
51	
52	两个"version"概念独立，不混淆：
53	
54	| 概念 | 字段 | 类型 | 用途 |
55	|------|------|------|------|
56	| 并发控制版本 | `FormTemplate.version` | INT | 乐观锁，每次 UPDATE +1 |
57	| Schema 格式版本 | `schema.schemaVersion` | VARCHAR(20) | 语义版本，代表 JSON 结构的格式 |
58	
59	### 导出兼容策略（Q-06）
60	
61	导入时比较 major 版本：
62	- `import.major === system.major` → 允许
63	- `import.major > system.major` → 拒绝（"配置文件版本过高"）
64	- `import.major < system.major` → 拒绝（"配置文件版本过旧，请使用迁移工具"）
65	
66	## 替代方案
67	
68	### 不版本化 API
69	
70	路由不加前缀，等需要时再加。**拒绝原因**：现在加是改路由字符串（成本≈0），以后加是需要同时维护 `/api/v1/...` 和 `/api/v2/...` 两套处理器并逐步迁移客户端（成本≈多周）。
71	
72	### 运行时多版本 Schema 兼容
73	
74	引擎同时支持 v1 和 v2 格式，按 `schemaVersion` 选择不同的解析逻辑。**拒绝原因**：解析器复杂度随版本数线性增长，且每个版本组合可能有隐蔽的交互 bug。一次只支持一个版本更安全。
75	
76	## 后果
77	
78	- **正面**：零成本在第一时间建立版本边界
79	- **正面**：`schemaVersion` 既用于存储校验也用于导出兼容检查——单一事实来源
80	- **负面**：大版本升级时需要手动运行迁移脚本——但大版本升级本身就应该有人工验证步骤
81
```
</details></tool-use>

+import type { FieldType } from "form-engine-core";
+import { FIELD_PALETTE, FIELD_TYPE_MIME } from "./palette";
+
+export interface ComponentPaletteProps {
+  /** Called when a palette item is dropped or clicked. */
+  onAddField: (type: FieldType) => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Left rail — the draggable field types. Each item is HTML5-draggable (drag the
+ * payload to the canvas) and clickable/Enter-activatable for accessibility.
+ */
+export const ComponentPalette: React.FC<ComponentPaletteProps> = ({
+  onAddField,
+}) => (
+  <div className="palette">
+    <h2 className="palette-title">组件面板</h2>
+    <div className="palette-list" role="listbox" aria-label="字段组件">
+      {FIELD_PALETTE.map((item) => (
+        <div
+          key={item.type}
+          className="palette-item"
+          role="option"
+          aria-label={`添加${item.label}`}
+          tabIndex={0}
+          draggable
+          onDragStart={(e) => {
+            e.dataTransfer.setData(FIELD_TYPE_MIME, item.type);
+            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
+          }}
+          onClick={() => onAddField(item.type)}
+          onKeyDown={(e) => {
+            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
+              e.preventDefault();
+              onAddField(item.type);
+            }
+          }}
+        >
+          <span className="palette-item-label">{item.label}</span>
+          <span className="palette-item-desc">{item.description}</span>
+        </div>
+      ))}
+    </div>
+  </div>
+);

34	+            e.dataTransfer.setData(FIELD_TYPE_MIME, item.type);
35	+            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
36	+          }}
37	+          onClick={() => onAddField(item.type)}
38	+          onKeyDown={(e) => {
39	+            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
40	+              e.preventDefault();
41	+              onAddField(item.type);
42	+            }
43	+          }}
44	+        >
45	+          <span className="palette-item-label">{item.label}</span>
46	+          <span className="palette-item-desc">{item.description}</span>
47	+        </div>
48	+      ))}
49	+    </div>
50	+  </div>
51	+);

58	+import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
59	+import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
60	+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
61	+import { DesignCanvas } from "./DesignCanvas";
62	+import type { DesignerSchema } from "./schemaModel";
63	+
64	+const schema: DesignerSchema = {
65	+  schemaVersion: "1.0.0",
66	+  sections: [
67	+    {
68	+      id: "sec-1",
69	+      title: "基础信息",
70	+      fields: [
71	+        { id: "fld-1", type: "text", label: "姓名", required: false },
72	+        { id: "fld-2", type: "select", label: "部门", required: false },
73	+      ],
74	+    },
75	+  ],
76	+};
77	+
78	+function renderCanvas(overrides: Partial<Parameters<typeof DesignCanvas>[0]> = {}) {
79	+  const props = {
80	+    schema,
81	+    selectedFieldId: null,
82	+    onDropField: vi.fn(),
83	+    onSelectField: vi.fn(),
84	+    onMoveField: vi.fn(),
85	+    onReorderField: vi.fn(),
86	+    onRemoveField: vi.fn(),
87	+    onAddSection: vi.fn(),
88	+    onUpdateSectionTitle: vi.fn(),
89	+    ...overrides,
90	+  };
91	+  render(<DesignCanvas {...props} />);
92	+  return props;
93	+}
94	+
95	+describe("DesignCanvas", () => {
96	+  it("renders section title, field labels and type names", () => {
97	+    renderCanvas();
98	+    expect(screen.getByDisplayValue("基础信息")).toBeInTheDocument();
99	+    expect(screen.getByText("姓名")).toBeInTheDocument();
100	+    expect(screen.getByText("部门")).toBeInTheDocument();
101	+    expect(screen.getAllByText("单行文本")).toHaveLength(1);
102	+  });
103	+
104	+  it("selects a field on click", async () => {
105	+    const { onSelectField } = renderCanvas();
106	+    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText("姓名"));
107	+    expect(onSelectField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("fld-1");
108	+  });
109	+
110	+  it("moves a field down via the down button", async () => {
111	+    const { onMoveField } = renderCanvas();

113	+    expect(onMoveField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sec-1", "fld-1", 1);
114	+  });
115	+
116	+  it("removes a field", async () => {

128	diff --git a/client/src/designer/DesignCanvas.tsx b/client/src/designer/DesignCanvas.tsx
129	new file mode 100644
130	index 0000000..0b0b8fe
131	--- /dev/null
132	+++ b/client/src/designer/DesignCanvas.tsx
133	@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
134	+import type { FieldType } from "form-engine-core";
135	+import { FIELD_LABELS, type DesignerSchema } from "./schemaModel";
136	+import { FIELD_REORDER_MIME, FIELD_TYPE_MIME } from "./palette";
137	+
138	+export interface DesignCanvasProps {
139	+  schema: DesignerSchema;
140	+  selectedFieldId: string | null;
141	+  onDropField: (type: FieldType) => void;
142	+  onSelectField: (fieldId: string | null) => void;
143	+  onMoveField: (sectionId: string, fieldId: string, delta: -1 | 1) => void;
144	+  onReorderField: (sectionId: string, fieldId: string, targetIndex: number) => void;
145	+  onRemoveField: (sectionId: string, fieldId: string) => void;
146	+  onAddSection: () => void;
147	+  onUpdateSectionTitle: (sectionId: string, title: string) => void;
148	+}
149	+
150	+/**
151	+ * Center column — the drop target and section/field list. Field types dropped
152	+ * from the palette are appended to the target section; field rows can be
153	+ * reordered by drag handle or up/down buttons, and selected to edit properties.
154	+ */
155	+export const DesignCanvas: React.FC<DesignCanvasProps> = ({
156	+  schema,
157	+  selectedFieldId,
158	+  onDropField,
159	+  onSelectField,
160	+  onMoveField,
161	+  onReorderField,
162	+  onRemoveField,
163	+  onAddSection,
164	+  onUpdateSectionTitle,
165	+}) => {
166	+  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
167	+    e.preventDefault();
168	+    const type = e.dataTransfer.getData(FIELD_TYPE_MIME) as FieldType;
169	+    if (type) onDropField(type);
170	+  };
171	+
172	+  return (
173	+    <div
174	+      className="canvas"
175	+      onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
176	+      onDrop={handleDrop}
177	+    >
178	+      <div className="canvas-toolbar">
179	+        <span className="canvas-hint">拖拽字段到此处，点击字段编辑属性</span>
180	+        <button type="button" className="canvas-add-section" onClick={onAddSection}>
181	+          + 添加章节
182	+        </button>
183	+      </div>
184	+
185	+      {schema.sections.length === 0 && (
186	+        <div className="canvas-empty">从左侧拖拽字段组件到画布开始设计</div>
187	+      )}
188	+
189	+      {schema.sections.map((section) => (
190	+        <section className="canvas-section" key={section.id}>
191	+          <header className="canvas-section-header">
192	+            <input
193	+              className="canvas-section-title"
194	+              value={section.title}
195	+              aria-label="章节标题"
196	+              onChange={(e) => onUpdateSectionTitle(section.id, e.target.value)}
197	+            />
198	+            <span className="canvas-section-count">{section.fields.length} 个字段</span>
199	+          </header>
200	+
201	+          <div className="canvas-fields">
202	+            {section.fields.length === 0 && (
203	+              <div className="canvas-fields-empty">拖拽字段到此章节</div>
204	+            )}
205	+            {section.fields.map((field, index) => (
206	+              <div
207	+                key={field.id}
208	+                className={
209	+                  field.id === selectedFieldId
210	+                    ? "canvas-field selected"
211	+                    : "canvas-field"
212	+                }
213	+                onClick={() => onSelectField(field.id)}
214	+                onDragOver={(e) => {
215	+                  if (e.dataTransfer.types.includes(FIELD_REORDER_MIME)) {
216	+                    e.preventDefault();
217	+                    e.stopPropagation();
218	+                  }
219	+                }}
220	+                onDrop={(e) => {
221	+                  e.stopPropagation();
222	+                  const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData(FIELD_REORDER_MIME);
223	+                  if (!raw) return;
224	+                  try {
225	+                    const { fieldId } = JSON.parse(raw) as { fieldId: string };
226	+                    if (fieldId && fieldId !== field.id) {
227	+                      onReorderField(section.id, fieldId, index);
228	+                    }
229	+                  } catch {
230	+                    // Ignore malformed reorder payloads.
231	+                  }
232	+                }}
233	+              >
234	+                <span
235	+                  className="canvas-field-handle"
236	+                  title="拖拽排序"
237	+                  draggable
238	+                  onDragStart={(e) => {
239	+                    e.dataTransfer.setData(
240	+                      FIELD_REORDER_MIME,
241	+                      JSON.stringify({ fieldId: field.id, sectionId: section.id }),
242	+                    );
243	+                    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
244	+                  }}
245	+                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
246	+                  aria-label="拖拽排序"
247	+                >
248	+                  ⋮⋮
249	+                </span>
250	+
251	+                <div className="canvas-field-info" onClick={() => onSelectField(field.id)}>
252	+                  <span className="canvas-field-label">{field.label}</span>
253	+                  <span className="canvas-field-type">{FIELD_LABELS[field.type]}</span>
254	+                </div>
255	+
256	+                <div className="canvas-field-actions" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
257	+                  <button
258	+                    type="button"
259	+                    aria-label="上移"
260	+                    disabled={index === 0}
261	+                    onClick={() => onMoveField(section.id, field.id, -1)}
262	+                  >
263	+                    ↑
264	+                  </button>
265	+                  <button
266	+                    type="button"
267	+                    aria-label="下移"
268	+                    disabled={index === section.fields.length - 1}
269	+                    onClick={() => onMoveField(section.id, field.id, 1)}
270	+                  >
271	+                    ↓
272	+                  </button>
273	+                  <button
274	+                    type="button"
275	+                    aria-label="删除字段"
276	+                    onClick={() => onRemoveField(section.id, field.id)}
277	+                  >
278	+                    ✕
279	+                  </button>
280	+                </div>
281	+              </div>
282	+            ))}
283	+          </div>
284	+        </section>
285	+      ))}
286	+    </div>
287	+  );
288	+};

371	+

388	diff --git a/client/src/designer/PropertyPanel.tsx b/client/src/designer/PropertyPanel.tsx
389	new file mode 100644
390	index 0000000..94b8f34
391	--- /dev/null
392	+++ b/client/src/designer/PropertyPanel.tsx
393	@@ -0,0 +1,362 @@
394	+import { useState } from "react";
395	+import type {
396	+  ApprovalChain,
397	+  ApprovalNode,
398	+  FieldSchema,
399	+  InfoTextStyle,
400	+  SelectOption,
401	+  ValidationRuleType,
402	+} from "form-engine-core";
403	+import { Form } from "../form/Form";
404	+import { removeRule, setRule, type DesignerSchema } from "./schemaModel";
405	+
406	+type TabKey = "props" | "approval" | "preview";
407	+
408	+export interface PropertyPanelProps {
409	+  schema: DesignerSchema;
410	+  /** The selected field (with its owning section) or null when nothing is selected. */
411	+  selected: { sectionId: string; field: FieldSchema } | null;
412	+  approvalChain?: ApprovalChain;
413	+  onChangeField: (
414	+    sectionId: string,
415	+    fieldId: string,
416	+    patch: Partial<FieldSchema>,
417	+  ) => void;
418	+}
419	+
420	+/**
421	+ * Right panel — three tabs: 属性 (dynamic field config by fieldType), 审批链
422	+ * (read-only approval chain for the MVP, which publishes without approval), and
423	+ * 预览 (read-only FormEngine rendered from the current schema).
424	+ */
425	+export const PropertyPanel: React.FC<PropertyPanelProps> = ({
426	+  schema,
427	+  selected,
428	+  approvalChain,
429	+  onChangeField,
430	+}) => {
431	+  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabKey>("props");
432	+
433	+  const tabs: { key: TabKey; label: string }[] = [
434	+    { key: "props", label: "属性" },
435	+    { key: "approval", label: "审批链" },
436	+    { key: "preview", label: "预览" },
437	+  ];
438	+
439	+  return (
440	+    <div className="panel">
441	+      <div className="panel-tabs" role="tablist">
442	+        {tabs.map((t) => (
443	+          <button
444	+            key={t.key}
445	+            type="button"
446	+            role="tab"
447	+            aria-selected={tab === t.key}
448	+            className={tab === t.key ? "panel-tab active" : "panel-tab"}
449	+            onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
450	+          >
451	+            {t.label}
452	+          </button>
453	+        ))}
454	+      </div>
455	+      <div className="panel-body">
456	+        {tab === "props" && (
457	+          <PropsTab selected={selected} onChangeField={onChangeField} />
458	+        )}
459	+        {tab === "approval" && <ApprovalTab approvalChain={approvalChain} />}
460	+        {tab === "preview" && <PreviewTab schema={schema} />}
461	+      </div>
462	+    </div>
463	+  );
464	+};
465	+
466	+// ── 属性 tab ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
467	+
468	+function PropsTab({
469	+  selected,
470	+  onChangeField,
471	+}: {
472	+  selected: PropertyPanelProps["selected"];
473	+  onChangeField: PropertyPanelProps["onChangeField"];
474	+}) {
475	+  if (!selected) {
476	+    return <p className="panel-empty">请选择一个字段以编辑属性</p>;
477	+  }
478	+  const { sectionId, field } = selected;
479	+  const update = (patch: Partial<FieldSchema>) =>
480	+    onChangeField(sectionId, field.id, patch);
481	+
482	+  return (
483	+    <div className="props-editor">
484	+      <h3 className="props-title">{field.type}</h3>
485	+
486	+      <label className="prop-field">
487	+        <span>标签</span>
488	+        <input
489	+          value={field.label}
490	+          onChange={(e) => update({ label: e.target.value })}
491	+        />
492	+      </label>
493	+
494	+      <label className="prop-field">
495	+        <span>占位提示</span>
496	+        <input
497	+          value={field.placeholder ?? ""}
498	+          placeholder="占位提示"
499	+          onChange={(e) => update({ placeholder: e.target.value })}
500	+        />
501	+      </label>
502	+
503	+      <label className="prop-field">
504	+        <span>帮助文本</span>
505	+        <input
506	+          value={field.helpText ?? ""}
507	+          placeholder="帮助文本"
508	+          onChange={(e) => update({ helpText: e.target.value })}
509	+        />
510	+      </label>
511	+
512	+      <label className="prop-check">
513	+        <input
514	+          type="checkbox"
515	+          checked={field.required}
516	+          onChange={(e) => update({ required: e.target.checked })}
517	+        />
518	+        <span>必填</span>
519	+      </label>
520	+
521	+      {(field.type === "select" ||
522	+        field.type === "radio" ||
523	+        field.type === "checkbox") && (
524	+        <OptionsEditor options={field.options ?? []} onChange={update} />
525	+      )}
526	+
527	+      {(field.type === "text" || field.type === "textarea") && (
528	+        <RuleEditor
529	+          rules={[
530	+            { type: "minLength", label: "最小长度", numeric: true },
531	+            { type: "maxLength", label: "最大长度", numeric: true },
532	+            { type: "regex", label: "正则表达式", numeric: false },
533	+          ]}
534	+          field={field}
535	+          onChange={update}
536	+        />
537	+      )}
538	+
539	+      {field.type === "number" && (
540	+        <RuleEditor
541	+          rules={[
542	+            { type: "min", label: "最小值", numeric: true },
543	+            { type: "max", label: "最大值", numeric: true },
544	+          ]}
545	+          field={field}
546	+          onChange={update}
547	+        />
548	+      )}
549	+
550	+      {field.type === "file" && (
551	+        <>
552	+          <label className="prop-field">
553	+            <span>允许类型（逗号分隔）</span>
554	+            <input
555	+              value={(field.allowTypes ?? []).join(",")}
556	+              onChange={(e) =>
557	+                update({
558	+                  allowTypes: e.target.value
559	+                    .split(",")
560	+                    .map((s) => s.trim())
561	+                    .filter(Boolean),
562	+                })
563	+              }
564	+            />
565	+          </label>
566	+          <label className="prop-field">
567	+            <span>最大大小（MB）</span>
568	+            <input
569	+              type="number"
570	+              value={field.maxSizeMB ?? ""}
571	+              onChange={(e) => update({ maxSizeMB: Number(e.target.value) })}
572	+            />
573	+          </label>
574	+          <label className="prop-field">
575	+            <span>最大数量</span>
576	+            <input
577	+              type="number"
578	+              value={field.maxCount ?? ""}
579	+              onChange={(e) => update({ maxCount: Number(e.target.value) })}
580	+            />
581	+          </label>
582	+        </>
583	+      )}
584	+
585	+      {field.type === "user-picker" && (
586	+        <label className="prop-check">
587	+          <input
588	+            type="checkbox"
589	+            checked={field.multiple ?? false}
590	+            onChange={(e) => update({ multiple: e.target.checked })}
591	+          />
592	+          <span>允许多选</span>
593	+        </label>
594	+      )}
595	+
596	+      {field.type === "info-text" && (
597	+        <>
598	+          <label className="prop-field">
599	+            <span>说明文字</span>
600	+            <textarea
601	+              value={field.text ?? ""}
602	+              onChange={(e) => update({ text: e.target.value })}
603	+            />
604	+          </label>
605	+          <label className="prop-field">
606	+            <span>样式</span>
607	+            <select
608	+              value={field.styleType ?? "info"}
609	+              onChange={(e) =>
610	+                update({ styleType: e.target.value as InfoTextStyle })
611	+              }
612	+            >
613	+              <option value="info">信息</option>
614	+              <option value="warning">警告</option>
615	+              <option value="danger">危险</option>
616	+            </select>
617	+          </label>
618	+        </>
619	+      )}
620	+    </div>
621	+  );
622	+}
623	+
624	+function OptionsEditor({
625	+  options,
626	+  onChange,
627	+}: {
628	+  options: SelectOption[];
629	+  onChange: (patch: Partial<FieldSchema>) => void;
630	+}) {
631	+  const setOption = (index: number, patch: Partial<SelectOption>) => {
632	+    const next = options.map((o, i) => (i === index ? { ...o, ...patch } : o));
633	+    onChange({ options: next });
634	+  };
635	+
636	+  return (
637	+    <div className="options-editor">
638	+      <span className="prop-label">选项</span>
639	+      {options.map((option, index) => (
640	+        <div className="option-row" key={index}>
641	+          <input
642	+            aria-label={`选项${index + 1}标签`}
643	+            value={option.label}
644	+            onChange={(e) => setOption(index, { label: e.target.value })}
645	+          />
646	+          <input
647	+            aria-label={`选项${index + 1}值`}
648	+            value={option.value}
649	+            onChange={(e) => setOption(index, { value: e.target.value })}
650	+          />
651	+          <button
652	+            type="button"
653	+            aria-label={`删除选项${index + 1}`}
654	+            onClick={() => onChange({ options: options.filter((_, i) => i !== index) })}
655	+          >
656	+            ✕
657	+          </button>
658	+        </div>
659	+      ))}
660	+      <button
661	+        type="button"
662	+        className="options-add"
663	+        onClick={() =>
664	+          onChange({
665	+            options: [...options, { label: "新选项", value: `option${options.length + 1}` }],
666	+          })
667	+        }
668	+      >
669	+        + 添加选项
670	+      </button>
671	+    </div>
672	+  );
673	+}
674	+
675	+function RuleEditor({
676	+  rules,
677	+  field,
678	+  onChange,
679	+}: {
680	+  rules: { type: ValidationRuleType; label: string; numeric: boolean }[];
681	+  field: FieldSchema;
682	+  onChange: (patch: Partial<FieldSchema>) => void;
683	+}) {
684	+  return (
685	+    <div className="rules-editor">
686	+      <span className="prop-label">验证规则</span>
687	+      {rules.map(({ type, label, numeric }) => {
688	+        const rule = field.validation?.rules.find((r) => r.type === type);
689	+        const raw = rule?.value;
690	+        const value = raw == null ? "" : String(raw);
691	+        return (
692	+          <label className="prop-field" key={type}>
693	+            <span>{label}</span>
694	+            <input
695	+              type={numeric ? "number" : "text"}
696	+              value={value}
697	+              placeholder="留空表示不校验"
698	+              onChange={(e) => {
699	+                const v = e.target.value;
700	+                if (v === "") {
701	+                  onChange({ validation: removeRule(field, type).validation });
702	+                  return;
703	+                }
704	+                const next = setRule(field, type, {
705	+                  value: numeric ? Number(v) : v,
706	+                });
707	+                onChange({ validation: next.validation });
708	+              }}
709	+            />
710	+          </label>
711	+        );
712	+      })}
713	+    </div>
714	+  );
715	+}
716	+
717	+// ── 审批链 tab ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
718	+
719	+function describeRule(node: ApprovalNode): string {
720	+  const rule = node.approverRule;
721	+  if (rule.type === "specific") return `指定人员：${rule.userId}`;
722	+  if (rule.type === "role") return `角色：${rule.roleId}`;
723	+  return rule.relation === "direct_manager" ? "直属上级" : "部门主管";
724	+}
725	+
726	+function ApprovalTab({ approvalChain }: { approvalChain?: ApprovalChain }) {
727	+  const nodes = approvalChain?.nodes ?? [];
728	+  if (nodes.length === 0) {
729	+    return <p className="panel-empty">无审批链（模板可直接发布）</p>;
730	+  }
731	+  return (
732	+    <ol className="approval-list">
733	+      {nodes.map((node) => (
734	+        <li className="approval-node" key={node.id}>
735	+          <span className="approval-order">{node.order + 1}</span>
736	+          <span className="approval-label">{node.label ?? "审批节点"}</span>
737	+          <span className="approval-rule">{describeRule(node)}</span>
738	+        </li>
739	+      ))}
740	+    </ol>
741	+  );
742	+}
743	+
744	+// ── 预览 tab ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
745	+
746	+function PreviewTab({ schema }: { schema: DesignerSchema }) {
747	+  if (schema.sections.length === 0) {
748	+    return <p className="panel-empty">暂无字段可预览</p>;
749	+  }
750	+  return (
751	+    <div className="preview">
752	+      <Form schema={schema} readOnly />
753	+    </div>
754	+  );
755	+}

997	diff --git a/client/src/designer/schemaModel.ts b/client/src/designer/schemaModel.ts
998	new file mode 100644
999	index 0000000..c883a89
1000	--- /dev/null
1001	+++ b/client/src/designer/schemaModel.ts
1002	@@ -0,0 +1,247 @@
1003	+import type {
1004	+  FieldSchema,
1005	+  FieldType,
1006	+  FieldValidation,
1007	+  SectionSchema,
1008	+  ValidationRule,
1009	+  ValidationRuleType,
1010	+} from "form-engine-core";
1011	+
1012	+/**
1013	+ * Designer schema model — pure helpers for building/editing the raw `schema`
1014	+ * JSONB a designer edits (sections → fields). Everything here is a pure function
1015	+ * returning new objects (no mutation), so it is unit-testable without a DOM.
1016	+ */
1017	+
1018	+export interface DesignerSchema {
1019	+  schemaVersion: string;
1020	+  sections: SectionSchema[];
1021	+}
1022	+
1023	+export const DESIGNER_SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0.0";
1024	+
1025	+/** Field-type → default label shown for a freshly dragged field. */
1026	+export const FIELD_LABELS: Record<FieldType, string> = {
1027	+  text: "单行文本",
1028	+  textarea: "多行文本",
1029	+  number: "数字",
1030	+  select: "下拉选择",
1031	+  radio: "单选",
1032	+  checkbox: "多选",
1033	+  date: "日期",
1034	+  datetime: "日期时间",
1035	+  file: "附件上传",
1036	+  subform: "子表单",
1037	+  "user-picker": "人员选择",
1038	+  section: "分组标题",
1039	+  "info-text": "说明文字",
1040	+};
1041	+
1042	+let idCounter = 0;
1043	+
1044	+/** Generate a unique field/section id (UUID-backed when available). */
1045	+export function newId(prefix: string): string {
1046	+  idCounter += 1;
1047	+  const uuid =
1048	+    typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
1049	+      ? crypto.randomUUID()
1050	+      : `${Date.now()}-${idCounter}`;
1051	+  return `${prefix}-${uuid}`;
1052	+}
1053	+
1054	+export function createEmptySchema(): DesignerSchema {
1055	+  return { schemaVersion: DESIGNER_SCHEMA_VERSION, sections: [] };
1056	+}
1057	+
1058	+export function createSection(title = "未命名章节"): SectionSchema {
1059	+  return { id: newId("sec"), title, fields: [] };
1060	+}
1061	+
1062	+/** Build a new field with sensible defaults for its type. */
1063	+export function createField(type: FieldType): FieldSchema {
1064	+  const field: FieldSchema = {
1065	+    id: newId("fld"),
1066	+    type,
1067	+    label: FIELD_LABELS[type],
1068	+    required: false,
1069	+  };
1070	+
1071	+  switch (type) {
1072	+    case "select":
1073	+    case "radio":
1074	+    case "checkbox":
1075	+      field.options = [
1076	+        { label: "选项一", value: "option1" },
1077	+        { label: "选项二", value: "option2" },
1078	+      ];
1079	+      break;
1080	+    case "text":
1081	+    case "textarea":
1082	+      field.placeholder = "请输入内容";
1083	+      break;
1084	+    case "number":
1085	+      field.placeholder = "请输入数字";
1086	+      break;
1087	+    case "subform":
1088	+      field.subSchema = { fields: [] };
1089	+      break;
1090	+    case "user-picker":
1091	+      field.multiple = false;
1092	+      break;
1093	+    case "file":
1094	+      field.allowTypes = ["pdf", "png", "jpg"];
1095	+      field.maxSizeMB = 5;
1096	+      field.maxCount = 3;
1097	+      break;
1098	+    case "info-text":
1099	+      field.styleType = "info";
1100	+      field.text = "这是一段说明文字";
1101	+      break;
1102	+    case "date":
1103	+    case "datetime":
1104	+    case "section":
1105	+      break;
1106	+  }
1107	+
1108	+  return field;
1109	+}
1110	+
1111	+/** Add a default section when the schema has none (so a drop always has a home). */
1112	+export function ensureSection(schema: DesignerSchema): DesignerSchema {
1113	+  if (schema.sections.length > 0) return schema;
1114	+  return { ...schema, sections: [createSection()] };
1115	+}
1116	+
1117	+export function addSection(
1118	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1119	+  section: SectionSchema,
1120	+): DesignerSchema {
1121	+  return { ...schema, sections: [...schema.sections, section] };
1122	+}
1123	+
1124	+function mapSection(
1125	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1126	+  sectionId: string,
1127	+  fn: (section: SectionSchema) => SectionSchema,
1128	+): DesignerSchema {
1129	+  return {
1130	+    ...schema,
1131	+    sections: schema.sections.map((s) => (s.id === sectionId ? fn(s) : s)),
1132	+  };
1133	+}
1134	+
1135	+export function updateSection(
1136	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1137	+  sectionId: string,
1138	+  patch: Partial<SectionSchema>,
1139	+): DesignerSchema {
1140	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({ ...s, ...patch }));
1141	+}
1142	+
1143	+export function addField(
1144	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1145	+  sectionId: string,
1146	+  field: FieldSchema,
1147	+): DesignerSchema {
1148	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
1149	+    ...s,
1150	+    fields: [...s.fields, field],
1151	+  }));
1152	+}
1153	+
1154	+export function removeField(
1155	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1156	+  sectionId: string,
1157	+  fieldId: string,
1158	+): DesignerSchema {
1159	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
1160	+    ...s,
1161	+    fields: s.fields.filter((f) => f.id !== fieldId),
1162	+  }));
1163	+}
1164	+
1165	+export function updateField(
1166	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1167	+  sectionId: string,
1168	+  fieldId: string,
1169	+  patch: Partial<FieldSchema>,
1170	+): DesignerSchema {
1171	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
1172	+    ...s,
1173	+    fields: s.fields.map((f) => (f.id === fieldId ? { ...f, ...patch } : f)),
1174	+  }));
1175	+}
1176	+
1177	+/** Move a field up (delta -1) or down (delta +1) within its section. No-op at bounds. */
1178	+export function moveField(
1179	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1180	+  sectionId: string,
1181	+  fieldId: string,
1182	+  delta: -1 | 1,
1183	+): DesignerSchema {
1184	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => {
1185	+    const index = s.fields.findIndex((f) => f.id === fieldId);
1186	+    if (index < 0) return s;
1187	+    const target = index + delta;
1188	+    if (target < 0 || target >= s.fields.length) return s;
1189	+    const fields = [...s.fields];
1190	+    const [item] = fields.splice(index, 1);
1191	+    fields.splice(target, 0, item);
1192	+    return { ...s, fields };
1193	+  });
1194	+}
1195	+
1196	+/** Move a field to an absolute index within its section (drag-handle reorder). */
1197	+export function reorderField(
1198	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1199	+  sectionId: string,
1200	+  fieldId: string,
1201	+  targetIndex: number,
1202	+): DesignerSchema {
1203	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => {
1204	+    const from = s.fields.findIndex((f) => f.id === fieldId);
1205	+    if (from < 0) return s;
1206	+    const fields = [...s.fields];
1207	+    const [item] = fields.splice(from, 1);
1208	+    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(targetIndex, fields.length));
1209	+    fields.splice(clamped, 0, item);
1210	+    return { ...s, fields };
1211	+  });
1212	+}
1213	+
1214	+export function findField(
1215	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1216	+  fieldId: string,
1217	+): { sectionId: string; field: FieldSchema } | null {
1218	+  for (const section of schema.sections) {
1219	+    const field = section.fields.find((f) => f.id === fieldId);
1220	+    if (field) return { sectionId: section.id, field };
1221	+  }
1222	+  return null;
1223	+}
1224	+
1225	+/** Upsert a validation rule (e.g. minLength=10) into a field's validation rules. */
1226	+export function setRule(
1227	+  field: FieldSchema,
1228	+  ruleType: ValidationRuleType,
1229	+  patch: { value?: unknown; message?: string },
1230	+): FieldSchema {
1231	+  const rules: ValidationRule[] = field.validation?.rules ?? [];
1232	+  const existing = rules.find((r) => r.type === ruleType);
1233	+  const next: FieldValidation = {
1234	+    rules: existing
1235	+      ? rules.map((r) => (r.type === ruleType ? { ...r, ...patch } : r))
1236	+      : [...rules, { type: ruleType, ...patch }],
1237	+  };
1238	+  return { ...field, validation: next };
1239	+}
1240	+
1241	+export function removeRule(
1242	+  field: FieldSchema,
1243	+  ruleType: ValidationRuleType,
1244	+): FieldSchema {
1245	+  const rules = (field.validation?.rules ?? []).filter(
1246	+    (r) => r.type !== ruleType,
1247	+  );
1248	+  return { ...field, validation: { rules } };
1249	+}

1363	+export const CreateTemplatePage: React.FC = () => {

1370	+

1396	+            : "创建失败",

1398	+      setBusy(false);
1399	+    }
1400	+  };
1401	+
1402	+  return (

1487	+export const DesignerPage: React.FC = () => {

1490	+

1492	+  const [me, setMe] = useState<User | null>(null);
1493	+  const [schema, setSchema] = useState<DesignerSchema>(createEmptySchema());
1494	+  const [selectedFieldId, setSelectedFieldId] = useState<string | null>(null);
1495	+  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
1496	+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
1497	+  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
1498	+  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
1499	+  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
1500	+
1501	+  useEffect(() => {

1503	+    setLoading(true);
1504	+    Promise.all([

1506	+      apiClient<FormTemplate>(`/templates/${id}`),

1508	+      .then(([user, tpl]) => {

1510	+        setTemplate(tpl);
1511	+        setSchema(toDesignerSchema(tpl.schema));
1512	+      })
1513	+      .catch((err: unknown) => {
1514	+        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "加载失败");
1515	+      })
1516	+      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
1517	+  }, [id]);
1518	+
1519	+  const isHolder = useMemo(
1520	+    () =>
1521	+      template != null &&
1522	+      me != null &&
1523	+      template.locked_by != null &&
1524	+      template.locked_by === me.id,
1525	+    [template, me],
1526	+  );
1527	+
1528	+  const badge = useMemo(() => {
1529	+    if (!template) return null;
1530	+    if (isHolder) return { label: "编辑中", tone: "editing" as const };
1531	+    if (template.locked_by)
1532	+      return {
1533	+        label: `已锁定 - ${template.locked_by_name ?? "他人"}`,
1534	+        tone: "locked" as const,
1535	+      };
1536	+    return { label: "未签出", tone: "free" as const };
1537	+  }, [template, isHolder]);
1538	+
1539	+  const selected = useMemo(() => {

1544	+
1545	+  // ── schema mutations ──
1546	+
1547	+  const handleAddField = useCallback((type: FieldType) => {

1554	+  }, []);
1555	+

1557	+    (sectionId: string, fieldId: string, delta: -1 | 1) => {

1559	+      setDirty(true);

1561	+    [],
1562	+  );
1563	+
1564	+  const handleReorderField = useCallback(
1565	+    (sectionId: string, fieldId: string, targetIndex: number) => {

1567	+      setDirty(true);
1568	+    },
1569	+    [],
1570	+  );
1571	+
1572	+  const handleRemoveField = useCallback((sectionId: string, fieldId: string) => {

1577	+

1590	+

1598	+
1599	+  // ── server actions ──
1600	+
1601	+  const runAction = async (

1652	+  };
1653	+

1660	+    );
1661	+  };
1662	+

1665	+  }
1666	+
1667	+  if (error || !template) {

1676	+  }
1677	+
1678	+  const statusLabel =

1680	+      ? "已发布"

1684	+
1685	+  return (
1686	+    <div className="designer">

1697	+          </button>
1698	+          <button type="button" disabled={!isHolder || busy} onClick={handleCheckin}>
1699	+            签入
1700	+          </button>
1701	+          <button
1702	+            type="button"
1703	+            disabled={template.status !== "draft" || busy}

1713	+        </div>

1715	+
1716	+      {notice && <p className="designer-notice">{notice}</p>}
1717	+

1724	+          onSelectField={setSelectedFieldId}

1726	+          onReorderField={handleReorderField}
1727	+          onRemoveField={handleRemoveField}

25	+      {FIELD_PALETTE.map((item) => (
26	+        <div
27	+          key={item.type}
28	+          className="palette-item"
29	+          role="option"
30	+          aria-label={`添加${item.label}`}
31	+          tabIndex={0}
32	+          draggable
33	+          onDragStart={(e) => {
34	+            e.dataTransfer.setData(FIELD_TYPE_MIME, item.type);
35	+            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
36	+          }}
37	+          onClick={() => onAddField(item.type)}
38	+          onKeyDown={(e) => {
39	+            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
40	+              e.preventDefault();
41	+              onAddField(item.type);
42	+            }
43	+          }}
44	+        >
45	+          <span className="palette-item-label">{item.label}</span>
46	+          <span className="palette-item-desc">{item.description}</span>
47	+        </div>
48	+      ))}
49	+    </div>
50	+  </div>
51	+);

58	+import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
59	+import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
60	+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
61	+import { DesignCanvas } from "./DesignCanvas";
62	+import type { DesignerSchema } from "./schemaModel";
63	+
64	+const schema: DesignerSchema = {
65	+  schemaVersion: "1.0.0",
66	+  sections: [
67	+    {
68	+      id: "sec-1",
69	+      title: "基础信息",
70	+      fields: [
71	+        { id: "fld-1", type: "text", label: "姓名", required: false },
72	+        { id: "fld-2", type: "select", label: "部门", required: false },
73	+      ],
74	+    },
75	+  ],
76	+};
77	+
78	+function renderCanvas(overrides: Partial<Parameters<typeof DesignCanvas>[0]> = {}) {
79	+  const props = {
80	+    schema,
81	+    selectedFieldId: null,
82	+    onDropField: vi.fn(),
83	+    onSelectField: vi.fn(),
84	+    onMoveField: vi.fn(),
85	+    onReorderField: vi.fn(),
86	+    onRemoveField: vi.fn(),
87	+    onAddSection: vi.fn(),
88	+    onUpdateSectionTitle: vi.fn(),
89	+    ...overrides,
90	+  };
91	+  render(<DesignCanvas {...props} />);
92	+  return props;
93	+}
94	+
95	+describe("DesignCanvas", () => {
96	+  it("renders section title, field labels and type names", () => {
97	+    renderCanvas();
98	+    expect(screen.getByDisplayValue("基础信息")).toBeInTheDocument();
99	+    expect(screen.getByText("姓名")).toBeInTheDocument();
100	+    expect(screen.getByText("部门")).toBeInTheDocument();
101	+    expect(screen.getAllByText("单行文本")).toHaveLength(1);
102	+  });
103	+
104	+  it("selects a field on click", async () => {
105	+    const { onSelectField } = renderCanvas();
106	+    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText("姓名"));
107	+    expect(onSelectField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("fld-1");
108	+  });
109	+
110	+  it("moves a field down via the down button", async () => {
111	+    const { onMoveField } = renderCanvas();
112	+    await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByLabelText("下移")[0]);
113	+    expect(onMoveField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sec-1", "fld-1", 1);
114	+  });
115	+
116	+  it("removes a field", async () => {
117	+    const { onRemoveField } = renderCanvas();
118	+    await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByLabelText("删除字段")[0]);
119	+    expect(onRemoveField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sec-1", "fld-1");
120	+  });
121	+
122	+  it("adds a section", async () => {
123	+    const { onAddSection } = renderCanvas();
124	+    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText("+ 添加章节"));

127	+});
128	diff --git a/client/src/designer/DesignCanvas.tsx b/client/src/designer/DesignCanvas.tsx
129	new file mode 100644
130	index 0000000..0b0b8fe
131	--- /dev/null
132	+++ b/client/src/designer/DesignCanvas.tsx
133	@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
134	+import type { FieldType } from "form-engine-core";
135	+import { FIELD_LABELS, type DesignerSchema } from "./schemaModel";
136	+import { FIELD_REORDER_MIME, FIELD_TYPE_MIME } from "./palette";
137	+
138	+export interface DesignCanvasProps {
139	+  schema: DesignerSchema;
140	+  selectedFieldId: string | null;
141	+  onDropField: (type: FieldType) => void;
142	+  onSelectField: (fieldId: string | null) => void;
143	+  onMoveField: (sectionId: string, fieldId: string, delta: -1 | 1) => void;
144	+  onReorderField: (sectionId: string, fieldId: string, targetIndex: number) => void;
145	+  onRemoveField: (sectionId: string, fieldId: string) => void;
146	+  onAddSection: () => void;
147	+  onUpdateSectionTitle: (sectionId: string, title: string) => void;
148	+}
149	+
150	+/**
151	+ * Center column — the drop target and section/field list. Field types dropped
152	+ * from the palette are appended to the target section; field rows can be
153	+ * reordered by drag handle or up/down buttons, and selected to edit properties.
154	+ */
155	+export const DesignCanvas: React.FC<DesignCanvasProps> = ({
156	+  schema,
157	+  selectedFieldId,
158	+  onDropField,
159	+  onSelectField,
160	+  onMoveField,
161	+  onReorderField,
162	+  onRemoveField,
163	+  onAddSection,
164	+  onUpdateSectionTitle,
165	+}) => {
166	+  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
167	+    e.preventDefault();
168	+    const type = e.dataTransfer.getData(FIELD_TYPE_MIME) as FieldType;
169	+    if (type) onDropField(type);
170	+  };
171	+
172	+  return (
173	+    <div
174	+      className="canvas"
175	+      onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
176	+      onDrop={handleDrop}
177	+    >
178	+      <div className="canvas-toolbar">
179	+        <span className="canvas-hint">拖拽字段到此处，点击字段编辑属性</span>
180	+        <button type="button" className="canvas-add-section" onClick={onAddSection}>
181	+          + 添加章节
182	+        </button>
183	+      </div>
184	+
185	+      {schema.sections.length === 0 && (
186	+        <div className="canvas-empty">从左侧拖拽字段组件到画布开始设计</div>
187	+      )}
188	+
189	+      {schema.sections.map((section) => (
190	+        <section className="canvas-section" key={section.id}>
191	+          <header className="canvas-section-header">
192	+            <input
193	+              className="canvas-section-title"
194	+              value={section.title}
195	+              aria-label="章节标题"
196	+              onChange={(e) => onUpdateSectionTitle(section.id, e.target.value)}
197	+            />
198	+            <span className="canvas-section-count">{section.fields.length} 个字段</span>
199	+          </header>
200	+
201	+          <div className="canvas-fields">
202	+            {section.fields.length === 0 && (
203	+              <div className="canvas-fields-empty">拖拽字段到此章节</div>
204	+            )}
205	+            {section.fields.map((field, index) => (
206	+              <div
207	+                key={field.id}
208	+                className={
209	+                  field.id === selectedFieldId
210	+                    ? "canvas-field selected"
211	+                    : "canvas-field"
212	+                }
213	+                onClick={() => onSelectField(field.id)}
214	+                onDragOver={(e) => {
215	+                  if (e.dataTransfer.types.includes(FIELD_REORDER_MIME)) {
216	+                    e.preventDefault();
217	+                    e.stopPropagation();
218	+                  }
219	+                }}
220	+                onDrop={(e) => {
221	+                  e.stopPropagation();
222	+                  const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData(FIELD_REORDER_MIME);
223	+                  if (!raw) return;
224	+                  try {
225	+                    const { fieldId } = JSON.parse(raw) as { fieldId: string };
226	+                    if (fieldId && fieldId !== field.id) {
227	+                      onReorderField(section.id, fieldId, index);
228	+                    }
229	+                  } catch {
230	+                    // Ignore malformed reorder payloads.
231	+                  }
232	+                }}
233	+              >
234	+                <span
235	+                  className="canvas-field-handle"
236	+                  title="拖拽排序"
237	+                  draggable
238	+                  onDragStart={(e) => {
239	+                    e.dataTransfer.setData(
240	+                      FIELD_REORDER_MIME,
241	+                      JSON.stringify({ fieldId: field.id, sectionId: section.id }),
242	+                    );
243	+                    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
244	+                  }}
245	+                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
246	+                  aria-label="拖拽排序"
247	+                >
248	+                  ⋮⋮
249	+                </span>
250	+
251	+                <div className="canvas-field-info" onClick={() => onSelectField(field.id)}>
252	+                  <span className="canvas-field-label">{field.label}</span>
253	+                  <span className="canvas-field-type">{FIELD_LABELS[field.type]}</span>
254	+                </div>
255	+
256	+                <div className="canvas-field-actions" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
257	+                  <button
258	+                    type="button"
259	+                    aria-label="上移"
260	+                    disabled={index === 0}
261	+                    onClick={() => onMoveField(section.id, field.id, -1)}
262	+                  >
263	+                    ↑
264	+                  </button>
265	+                  <button
266	+                    type="button"
267	+                    aria-label="下移"
268	+                    disabled={index === section.fields.length - 1}
269	+                    onClick={() => onMoveField(section.id, field.id, 1)}
270	+                  >
271	+                    ↓
272	+                  </button>
273	+                  <button
274	+                    type="button"
275	+                    aria-label="删除字段"
276	+                    onClick={() => onRemoveField(section.id, field.id)}
277	+                  >
278	+                    ✕
279	+                  </button>
280	+                </div>
281	+              </div>
282	+            ))}
283	+          </div>
284	+        </section>
285	+      ))}
286	+    </div>
287	+  );
288	+};

365	+    expect(onChangeField).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sec-1", "fld-2", {

371	+
