388	diff --git a/client/src/designer/PropertyPanel.tsx b/client/src/designer/PropertyPanel.tsx
389	new file mode 100644
390	index 0000000..94b8f34
391	--- /dev/null
392	+++ b/client/src/designer/PropertyPanel.tsx
393	@@ -0,0 +1,362 @@
394	+import { useState } from "react";
395	+import type {
396	+  ApprovalChain,
397	+  ApprovalNode,
398	+  FieldSchema,
399	+  InfoTextStyle,
400	+  SelectOption,
401	+  ValidationRuleType,
402	+} from "form-engine-core";
403	+import { Form } from "../form/Form";
404	+import { removeRule, setRule, type DesignerSchema } from "./schemaModel";
405	+
406	+type TabKey = "props" | "approval" | "preview";
407	+
408	+export interface PropertyPanelProps {
409	+  schema: DesignerSchema;
410	+  /** The selected field (with its owning section) or null when nothing is selected. */
411	+  selected: { sectionId: string; field: FieldSchema } | null;
412	+  approvalChain?: ApprovalChain;
413	+  onChangeField: (
414	+    sectionId: string,
415	+    fieldId: string,
416	+    patch: Partial<FieldSchema>,
417	+  ) => void;
418	+}
419	+
420	+/**
421	+ * Right panel — three tabs: 属性 (dynamic field config by fieldType), 审批链
422	+ * (read-only approval chain for the MVP, which publishes without approval), and
423	+ * 预览 (read-only FormEngine rendered from the current schema).
424	+ */
425	+export const PropertyPanel: React.FC<PropertyPanelProps> = ({
426	+  schema,
427	+  selected,
428	+  approvalChain,
429	+  onChangeField,
430	+}) => {
431	+  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabKey>("props");
432	+
433	+  const tabs: { key: TabKey; label: string }[] = [
434	+    { key: "props", label: "属性" },
435	+    { key: "approval", label: "审批链" },
436	+    { key: "preview", label: "预览" },
437	+  ];
438	+
439	+  return (
440	+    <div className="panel">
441	+      <div className="panel-tabs" role="tablist">
442	+        {tabs.map((t) => (
443	+          <button
444	+            key={t.key}
445	+            type="button"
446	+            role="tab"
447	+            aria-selected={tab === t.key}
448	+            className={tab === t.key ? "panel-tab active" : "panel-tab"}
449	+            onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
450	+          >
451	+            {t.label}
452	+          </button>
453	+        ))}
454	+      </div>
455	+      <div className="panel-body">
456	+        {tab === "props" && (
457	+          <PropsTab selected={selected} onChangeField={onChangeField} />
458	+        )}
459	+        {tab === "approval" && <ApprovalTab approvalChain={approvalChain} />}
460	+        {tab === "preview" && <PreviewTab schema={schema} />}
461	+      </div>
462	+    </div>
463	+  );
464	+};
465	+
466	+// ── 属性 tab ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
467	+
468	+function PropsTab({
469	+  selected,
470	+  onChangeField,
471	+}: {
472	+  selected: PropertyPanelProps["selected"];
473	+  onChangeField: PropertyPanelProps["onChangeField"];
474	+}) {
475	+  if (!selected) {
476	+    return <p className="panel-empty">请选择一个字段以编辑属性</p>;
477	+  }
478	+  const { sectionId, field } = selected;
479	+  const update = (patch: Partial<FieldSchema>) =>
480	+    onChangeField(sectionId, field.id, patch);
481	+
482	+  return (
483	+    <div className="props-editor">
484	+      <h3 className="props-title">{field.type}</h3>
485	+
486	+      <label className="prop-field">
487	+        <span>标签</span>
488	+        <input
489	+          value={field.label}
490	+          onChange={(e) => update({ label: e.target.value })}
491	+        />
492	+      </label>
493	+
494	+      <label className="prop-field">
495	+        <span>占位提示</span>
496	+        <input
497	+          value={field.placeholder ?? ""}
498	+          placeholder="占位提示"
499	+          onChange={(e) => update({ placeholder: e.target.value })}
500	+        />
501	+      </label>
502	+
503	+      <label className="prop-field">
504	+        <span>帮助文本</span>
505	+        <input
506	+          value={field.helpText ?? ""}
507	+          placeholder="帮助文本"
508	+          onChange={(e) => update({ helpText: e.target.value })}
509	+        />
510	+      </label>
511	+
512	+      <label className="prop-check">
513	+        <input
514	+          type="checkbox"
515	+          checked={field.required}
516	+          onChange={(e) => update({ required: e.target.checked })}
517	+        />
518	+        <span>必填</span>
519	+      </label>
520	+
521	+      {(field.type === "select" ||
522	+        field.type === "radio" ||
523	+        field.type === "checkbox") && (
524	+        <OptionsEditor options={field.options ?? []} onChange={update} />
525	+      )}
526	+
527	+      {(field.type === "text" || field.type === "textarea") && (
528	+        <RuleEditor
529	+          rules={[
530	+            { type: "minLength", label: "最小长度", numeric: true },
531	+            { type: "maxLength", label: "最大长度", numeric: true },
532	+            { type: "regex", label: "正则表达式", numeric: false },
533	+          ]}
534	+          field={field}
535	+          onChange={update}
536	+        />
537	+      )}
538	+
539	+      {field.type === "number" && (
540	+        <RuleEditor
541	+          rules={[
542	+            { type: "min", label: "最小值", numeric: true },
543	+            { type: "max", label: "最大值", numeric: true },
544	+          ]}
545	+          field={field}
546	+          onChange={update}
547	+        />
548	+      )}
549	+
550	+      {field.type === "file" && (
551	+        <>
552	+          <label className="prop-field">
553	+            <span>允许类型（逗号分隔）</span>
554	+            <input
555	+              value={(field.allowTypes ?? []).join(",")}
556	+              onChange={(e) =>
557	+                update({
558	+                  allowTypes: e.target.value
559	+                    .split(",")
560	+                    .map((s) => s.trim())
561	+                    .filter(Boolean),
562	+                })
563	+              }
564	+            />
565	+          </label>
566	+          <label className="prop-field">
567	+            <span>最大大小（MB）</span>
568	+            <input
569	+              type="number"
570	+              value={field.maxSizeMB ?? ""}
571	+              onChange={(e) => update({ maxSizeMB: Number(e.target.value) })}
572	+            />
573	+          </label>
574	+          <label className="prop-field">
575	+            <span>最大数量</span>
576	+            <input
577	+              type="number"
578	+              value={field.maxCount ?? ""}
579	+              onChange={(e) => update({ maxCount: Number(e.target.value) })}
580	+            />
581	+          </label>
582	+        </>
583	+      )}
584	+
585	+      {field.type === "user-picker" && (
586	+        <label className="prop-check">
587	+          <input
588	+            type="checkbox"
589	+            checked={field.multiple ?? false}
590	+            onChange={(e) => update({ multiple: e.target.checked })}
591	+          />
592	+          <span>允许多选</span>
593	+        </label>
594	+      )}
595	+
596	+      {field.type === "info-text" && (
597	+        <>
598	+          <label className="prop-field">
599	+            <span>说明文字</span>
600	+            <textarea
601	+              value={field.text ?? ""}
602	+              onChange={(e) => update({ text: e.target.value })}
603	+            />
604	+          </label>
605	+          <label className="prop-field">
606	+            <span>样式</span>
607	+            <select
608	+              value={field.styleType ?? "info"}
609	+              onChange={(e) =>
610	+                update({ styleType: e.target.value as InfoTextStyle })
611	+              }
612	+            >
613	+              <option value="info">信息</option>
614	+              <option value="warning">警告</option>
615	+              <option value="danger">危险</option>
616	+            </select>
617	+          </label>
618	+        </>
619	+      )}
620	+    </div>
621	+  );
622	+}
623	+
624	+function OptionsEditor({
625	+  options,
626	+  onChange,
627	+}: {
628	+  options: SelectOption[];
629	+  onChange: (patch: Partial<FieldSchema>) => void;
630	+}) {
631	+  const setOption = (index: number, patch: Partial<SelectOption>) => {
632	+    const next = options.map((o, i) => (i === index ? { ...o, ...patch } : o));
633	+    onChange({ options: next });
634	+  };
635	+
636	+  return (
637	+    <div className="options-editor">
638	+      <span className="prop-label">选项</span>
639	+      {options.map((option, index) => (
640	+        <div className="option-row" key={index}>
641	+          <input
642	+            aria-label={`选项${index + 1}标签`}
643	+            value={option.label}
644	+            onChange={(e) => setOption(index, { label: e.target.value })}
645	+          />
646	+          <input
647	+            aria-label={`选项${index + 1}值`}
648	+            value={option.value}
649	+            onChange={(e) => setOption(index, { value: e.target.value })}
650	+          />
651	+          <button
652	+            type="button"
653	+            aria-label={`删除选项${index + 1}`}
654	+            onClick={() => onChange({ options: options.filter((_, i) => i !== index) })}
655	+          >
656	+            ✕
657	+          </button>
658	+        </div>
659	+      ))}
660	+      <button
661	+        type="button"
662	+        className="options-add"
663	+        onClick={() =>
664	+          onChange({
665	+            options: [...options, { label: "新选项", value: `option${options.length + 1}` }],
666	+          })
667	+        }
668	+      >
669	+        + 添加选项
670	+      </button>
671	+    </div>
672	+  );
673	+}
674	+
675	+function RuleEditor({
676	+  rules,
677	+  field,
678	+  onChange,
679	+}: {
680	+  rules: { type: ValidationRuleType; label: string; numeric: boolean }[];
681	+  field: FieldSchema;
682	+  onChange: (patch: Partial<FieldSchema>) => void;
683	+}) {
684	+  return (
685	+    <div className="rules-editor">
686	+      <span className="prop-label">验证规则</span>
687	+      {rules.map(({ type, label, numeric }) => {
688	+        const rule = field.validation?.rules.find((r) => r.type === type);
689	+        const raw = rule?.value;
690	+        const value = raw == null ? "" : String(raw);
691	+        return (
692	+          <label className="prop-field" key={type}>
693	+            <span>{label}</span>
694	+            <input
695	+              type={numeric ? "number" : "text"}
696	+              value={value}
697	+              placeholder="留空表示不校验"
698	+              onChange={(e) => {
699	+                const v = e.target.value;
700	+                if (v === "") {
701	+                  onChange({ validation: removeRule(field, type).validation });
702	+                  return;
703	+                }
704	+                const next = setRule(field, type, {
705	+                  value: numeric ? Number(v) : v,
706	+                });
707	+                onChange({ validation: next.validation });
708	+              }}
709	+            />
710	+          </label>
711	+        );
712	+      })}
713	+    </div>
714	+  );
715	+}
716	+
717	+// ── 审批链 tab ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
718	+
719	+function describeRule(node: ApprovalNode): string {
720	+  const rule = node.approverRule;
721	+  if (rule.type === "specific") return `指定人员：${rule.userId}`;
722	+  if (rule.type === "role") return `角色：${rule.roleId}`;
723	+  return rule.relation === "direct_manager" ? "直属上级" : "部门主管";
724	+}
725	+
726	+function ApprovalTab({ approvalChain }: { approvalChain?: ApprovalChain }) {
727	+  const nodes = approvalChain?.nodes ?? [];
728	+  if (nodes.length === 0) {
729	+    return <p className="panel-empty">无审批链（模板可直接发布）</p>;
730	+  }
731	+  return (
732	+    <ol className="approval-list">
733	+      {nodes.map((node) => (
734	+        <li className="approval-node" key={node.id}>
735	+          <span className="approval-order">{node.order + 1}</span>
736	+          <span className="approval-label">{node.label ?? "审批节点"}</span>
737	+          <span className="approval-rule">{describeRule(node)}</span>
738	+        </li>
739	+      ))}
740	+    </ol>
741	+  );
742	+}
743	+
744	+// ── 预览 tab ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
745	+
746	+function PreviewTab({ schema }: { schema: DesignerSchema }) {
747	+  if (schema.sections.length === 0) {
748	+    return <p className="panel-empty">暂无字段可预览</p>;
749	+  }
750	+  return (
751	+    <div className="preview">
752	+      <Form schema={schema} readOnly />
753	+    </div>
754	+  );
755	+}

997	diff --git a/client/src/designer/schemaModel.ts b/client/src/designer/schemaModel.ts
998	new file mode 100644
999	index 0000000..c883a89
1000	--- /dev/null
1001	+++ b/client/src/designer/schemaModel.ts
1002	@@ -0,0 +1,247 @@
1003	+import type {
1004	+  FieldSchema,
1005	+  FieldType,
1006	+  FieldValidation,
1007	+  SectionSchema,
1008	+  ValidationRule,
1009	+  ValidationRuleType,
1010	+} from "form-engine-core";
1011	+
1012	+/**
1013	+ * Designer schema model — pure helpers for building/editing the raw `schema`
1014	+ * JSONB a designer edits (sections → fields). Everything here is a pure function
1015	+ * returning new objects (no mutation), so it is unit-testable without a DOM.
1016	+ */
1017	+
1018	+export interface DesignerSchema {
1019	+  schemaVersion: string;
1020	+  sections: SectionSchema[];
1021	+}
1022	+
1023	+export const DESIGNER_SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0.0";
1024	+
1025	+/** Field-type → default label shown for a freshly dragged field. */
1026	+export const FIELD_LABELS: Record<FieldType, string> = {
1027	+  text: "单行文本",
1028	+  textarea: "多行文本",
1029	+  number: "数字",
1030	+  select: "下拉选择",
1031	+  radio: "单选",
1032	+  checkbox: "多选",
1033	+  date: "日期",
1034	+  datetime: "日期时间",
1035	+  file: "附件上传",
1036	+  subform: "子表单",
1037	+  "user-picker": "人员选择",
1038	+  section: "分组标题",
1039	+  "info-text": "说明文字",
1040	+};
1041	+
1042	+let idCounter = 0;
1043	+
1044	+/** Generate a unique field/section id (UUID-backed when available). */
1045	+export function newId(prefix: string): string {
1046	+  idCounter += 1;
1047	+  const uuid =
1048	+    typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
1049	+      ? crypto.randomUUID()
1050	+      : `${Date.now()}-${idCounter}`;
1051	+  return `${prefix}-${uuid}`;
1052	+}
1053	+
1054	+export function createEmptySchema(): DesignerSchema {
1055	+  return { schemaVersion: DESIGNER_SCHEMA_VERSION, sections: [] };
1056	+}
1057	+
1058	+export function createSection(title = "未命名章节"): SectionSchema {
1059	+  return { id: newId("sec"), title, fields: [] };
1060	+}
1061	+
1062	+/** Build a new field with sensible defaults for its type. */
1063	+export function createField(type: FieldType): FieldSchema {
1064	+  const field: FieldSchema = {
1065	+    id: newId("fld"),
1066	+    type,
1067	+    label: FIELD_LABELS[type],
1068	+    required: false,
1069	+  };
1070	+
1071	+  switch (type) {
1072	+    case "select":
1073	+    case "radio":
1074	+    case "checkbox":
1075	+      field.options = [
1076	+        { label: "选项一", value: "option1" },
1077	+        { label: "选项二", value: "option2" },
1078	+      ];
1079	+      break;
1080	+    case "text":
1081	+    case "textarea":
1082	+      field.placeholder = "请输入内容";
1083	+      break;
1084	+    case "number":
1085	+      field.placeholder = "请输入数字";
1086	+      break;
1087	+    case "subform":
1088	+      field.subSchema = { fields: [] };
1089	+      break;
1090	+    case "user-picker":
1091	+      field.multiple = false;
1092	+      break;
1093	+    case "file":
1094	+      field.allowTypes = ["pdf", "png", "jpg"];
1095	+      field.maxSizeMB = 5;
1096	+      field.maxCount = 3;
1097	+      break;
1098	+    case "info-text":
1099	+      field.styleType = "info";
1100	+      field.text = "这是一段说明文字";
1101	+      break;
1102	+    case "date":
1103	+    case "datetime":
1104	+    case "section":
1105	+      break;
1106	+  }
1107	+
1108	+  return field;
1109	+}
1110	+
1111	+/** Add a default section when the schema has none (so a drop always has a home). */
1112	+export function ensureSection(schema: DesignerSchema): DesignerSchema {
1113	+  if (schema.sections.length > 0) return schema;
1114	+  return { ...schema, sections: [createSection()] };
1115	+}
1116	+
1117	+export function addSection(
1118	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1119	+  section: SectionSchema,
1120	+): DesignerSchema {
1121	+  return { ...schema, sections: [...schema.sections, section] };
1122	+}
1123	+
1124	+function mapSection(
1125	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1126	+  sectionId: string,
1127	+  fn: (section: SectionSchema) => SectionSchema,
1128	+): DesignerSchema {
1129	+  return {
1130	+    ...schema,
1131	+    sections: schema.sections.map((s) => (s.id === sectionId ? fn(s) : s)),
1132	+  };
1133	+}
1134	+
1135	+export function updateSection(
1136	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1137	+  sectionId: string,
1138	+  patch: Partial<SectionSchema>,
1139	+): DesignerSchema {
1140	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({ ...s, ...patch }));
1141	+}
1142	+
1143	+export function addField(
1144	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1145	+  sectionId: string,
1146	+  field: FieldSchema,
1147	+): DesignerSchema {
1148	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
1149	+    ...s,
1150	+    fields: [...s.fields, field],
1151	+  }));
1152	+}
1153	+
1154	+export function removeField(
1155	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1156	+  sectionId: string,
1157	+  fieldId: string,
1158	+): DesignerSchema {
1159	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
1160	+    ...s,
1161	+    fields: s.fields.filter((f) => f.id !== fieldId),
1162	+  }));
1163	+}
1164	+
1165	+export function updateField(
1166	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1167	+  sectionId: string,
1168	+  fieldId: string,
1169	+  patch: Partial<FieldSchema>,
1170	+): DesignerSchema {
1171	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
1172	+    ...s,
1173	+    fields: s.fields.map((f) => (f.id === fieldId ? { ...f, ...patch } : f)),
1174	+  }));
1175	+}
1176	+
1177	+/** Move a field up (delta -1) or down (delta +1) within its section. No-op at bounds. */
1178	+export function moveField(
1179	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1180	+  sectionId: string,
1181	+  fieldId: string,
1182	+  delta: -1 | 1,
1183	+): DesignerSchema {
1184	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => {
1185	+    const index = s.fields.findIndex((f) => f.id === fieldId);
1186	+    if (index < 0) return s;
1187	+    const target = index + delta;
1188	+    if (target < 0 || target >= s.fields.length) return s;
1189	+    const fields = [...s.fields];
1190	+    const [item] = fields.splice(index, 1);
1191	+    fields.splice(target, 0, item);
1192	+    return { ...s, fields };
1193	+  });
1194	+}
1195	+
1196	+/** Move a field to an absolute index within its section (drag-handle reorder). */
1197	+export function reorderField(
1198	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1199	+  sectionId: string,
1200	+  fieldId: string,
1201	+  targetIndex: number,
1202	+): DesignerSchema {
1203	+  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => {
1204	+    const from = s.fields.findIndex((f) => f.id === fieldId);
1205	+    if (from < 0) return s;
1206	+    const fields = [...s.fields];
1207	+    const [item] = fields.splice(from, 1);
1208	+    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(targetIndex, fields.length));
1209	+    fields.splice(clamped, 0, item);
1210	+    return { ...s, fields };
1211	+  });
1212	+}
1213	+
1214	+export function findField(
1215	+  schema: DesignerSchema,
1216	+  fieldId: string,
1217	+): { sectionId: string; field: FieldSchema } | null {
1218	+  for (const section of schema.sections) {
1219	+    const field = section.fields.find((f) => f.id === fieldId);
1220	+    if (field) return { sectionId: section.id, field };
1221	+  }
1222	+  return null;
1223	+}
1224	+
1225	+/** Upsert a validation rule (e.g. minLength=10) into a field's validation rules. */
1226	+export function setRule(
1227	+  field: FieldSchema,
1228	+  ruleType: ValidationRuleType,
1229	+  patch: { value?: unknown; message?: string },
1230	+): FieldSchema {
1231	+  const rules: ValidationRule[] = field.validation?.rules ?? [];
1232	+  const existing = rules.find((r) => r.type === ruleType);
1233	+  const next: FieldValidation = {
1234	+    rules: existing
1235	+      ? rules.map((r) => (r.type === ruleType ? { ...r, ...patch } : r))
1236	+      : [...rules, { type: ruleType, ...patch }],
1237	+  };
1238	+  return { ...field, validation: next };
1239	+}
1240	+
1241	+export function removeRule(
1242	+  field: FieldSchema,
1243	+  ruleType: ValidationRuleType,
1244	+): FieldSchema {
1245	+  const rules = (field.validation?.rules ?? []).filter(
1246	+    (r) => r.type !== ruleType,
1247	+  );
1248	+  return { ...field, validation: { rules } };
1249	+}

1517	+  }, [id]);
1518	+

1527	+

```text
1	# ADR-0007：API 契约 —— Spec-first OpenAPI + openapi-typescript 类型生成
2	
3	> 日期：2026-08-13
4	> 状态：已采纳
5	> 关联：grilling 会话（前后端分离确认 + OpenAPI 引入）
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 背景
10	
11	项目为前后端分离的 SPA + REST API 架构（`server/` Express + `client/` React + `shared/` 纯逻辑）。客户端 [apiClient](../../client/src/config/api.ts) 是手写泛型、无类型契约；13 个工单将引入几十个端点，客户端与服务端的类型漂移是最大痛点。问：是否引入 OpenAPI 契约，以及契约从哪来、生成什么。
12	
13	## 决策
14	
15	1. **Spec-first**：手写 `openapi.yaml`（仓库根）作为 API 契约的单一事实来源。端点沿用 ADR-0005 的 `/api/v1` 前缀。
16	2. **类型生成**：用 `openapi-typescript` 从 spec 生成**纯类型**（无运行时），输出到 `shared/src/api.ts`（form-engine-core 包）。保留手写 `apiClient`（已封装 CSRF/cookie/错误处理），让它消费生成类型。
17	3. **完整度**：现在只写已实现的 `GET /api/v1/health` + 通用组件（错误 envelope、标准头 `Idempotency-Key`/`X-CSRF-Token`/`X-Trace-Id`）+ 核心资源 schema（`FormTemplate`/`FormInstance`/`ApprovalRecord`/`Draft`/`Notification`，来自 DB 迁移）。端点随工单逐个补，不前向写满 13 个工单。
18	4. **SSE**（工单 07 通知）不纳入 OpenAPI schema，单独说明——OpenAPI 3.x 对 SSE 支持弱。
19	
20	## 替代方案
21	
22	- **Code-first（Zod/tsoa 从代码生成 spec）**：拒绝。server 是裸 Express、无 request/response schema 层，需先重构所有 handler；且 spec-first 让后续工单能「按契约实现」。
23	- **生成完整 fetch client（@hey-api/openapi-ts）**：拒绝。现有 `apiClient` 已封装 CSRF 注入、credentials、错误 envelope 解析，替换无净收益。
24	- **前向写满 13 个工单所有端点**：拒绝。spec 会「撒谎」、TDD 过程中反复改。
25	
26	## 后果
27	
28	- **正面**：客户端与 server 共享单一类型契约，消除手写泛型漂移；后续工单有契约可依。
29	- **正面**：生成物是纯类型（零运行时依赖），符合 form-engine-core 定位。
30	- **负面**：手写 spec 可能漂移——靠「类型从 spec 生成 + 提交进 typecheck」约束，spec 更新仍需人工维护。运行时校验（express-openapi-validator）留待以后按需引入。
31
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
1	# ADR-0008：设计系统单一权威来源 —— 原型「画布工作台」token + 共享 shell
2	
3	> 日期：2026-08-13
4	> 状态：已采纳
5	> 关联：grilling 会话（设计系统对齐）
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 背景
10	
11	仓库里存在三套互相矛盾的设计 token 词汇，且没有任何一份文档化的权威：
12	
13	| 来源 | 品牌色 | 性质 |
14	|------|--------|------|
15	| `prototype/assets/app.css` | `--brand:#4f46e5`（indigo） | 唯一**刻意设计**的完整系统「画布工作台 Canvas Workbench」：色彩/圆角/阴影/字体/语义态齐全 |
16	| `client/src/styles/global.css` | `--color-primary:#1677ff`（antd 蓝） | Ant Design 默认色板，非设计选择 |
17	| `client/src/form/form.css` | 混合硬编码 antd 色 | 与上面两套都不同 |
18	
19	门户壳同理：原型是浅色侧栏（236px）+ 顶栏（60px）+ indigo 品牌；代码 `AdminLayout` 是 antd 深色侧栏 `#001529`（240px/56px），`UserLayout` 只有顶栏无侧栏。问：以哪一套为唯一权威，其余全部对齐。
20	
21	## 决策
22	
23	1. **设计 token 以原型 `prototype/assets/app.css` 为唯一权威**。设计系统名为「画布工作台 Canvas Workbench」。antd 蓝全部弃用；命名一并采纳原型方案（`--brand`、`--text-2`、`--r-lg`…，而非 `--color-primary`、`--color-text-secondary`）。
24	2. **门户壳为一套共享 shell**：浅色侧栏 236px + 顶栏 60px + indigo 品牌，5 个角色门户复用同一 shell、仅导航项不同；`designer-edit` 保留独立的 `.editor` 三栏全屏工作台。
25	
26	## 替代方案
27	
28	- **以代码 antd 蓝为准，把原型改回 antd**：拒绝。antd 色板是未设计的默认值，原型才是唯一经过设计的 token 系统；保留 antd 等于放弃已投入的设计。
29	- **每角色独立 chrome（设计者侧栏 / 填写者顶栏 / 审批移动优先）**：拒绝。MVP 阶段单一共享 shell 更省，且「按角色显示不同导航」已在路由层通过不同导航项体现，不需要不同的壳。
30	
31	## 后果
32	
33	- **正面**：token 有了单一权威，代码/原型/文档不再漂移。
34	- **负面**：需全局重写 `client` 的 CSS（`global.css` + `form.css` + 两个 layout 的内联样式）——这是一次性的机械改动，随工单进行。
35	- **负面**：未来读者会困惑「为何弃用 antd 蓝、为何颜色变 indigo」——本 ADR 记录原因。
36
```
</details></tool-use>

1	# ADR-0009：门户路由模型 —— 5 角色门户，`/designer` 而非 `/admin`
2	
3	> 日期：2026-08-13
4	> 状态：已采纳
5	> 关联：grilling 会话（设计系统对齐）
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 背景
10	
11	三份文档/代码对「门户路由模型」给出互相矛盾的答案：
12	
13	| 来源 | 模型 | `/admin` 含义 |
14	|------|------|---------------|
15	| `design-spec-form-engine.md` §5.1 | 2 门户：设计器端 `/admin` + 填写器端 `/`（审批/数据/统计混在填写器端） | 设计者门户 |
16	| `sitemap-form-engine.md` | 5 角色门户：`/designer` `/filler` `/approver` `/admin` `/ops`（约 40 路由） | 系统管理员门户 |
17	| `client/src/router/index.tsx` | 2 layout（`AdminLayout`/`UserLayout`），跟随 design-spec | 设计者门户 |
18	
19	`/admin` 存在语义冲突：design-spec 与代码里它是「设计者门户」，sitemap 里它是「系统管理员门户」。问：哪一份是唯一权威。
20	
21	## 决策
22	
23	**以 `sitemap-form-engine.md` 的 5 角色门户（单 SPA）为唯一权威。** 具体：
24	
25	1. 五个角色门户：`/designer`（模板设计者）、`/filler`（表单填写者）、`/approver`（审批人）、`/admin`（系统管理员）、`/ops`（运维人员）。
26	2. `/admin` 归「系统管理员」；**设计者门户改用 `/designer`**。
27	3. `design-spec-form-engine.md` §5.1 与 `client/src/router/index.tsx` 重写对齐（`AdminLayout`/`UserLayout` 合并为按角色渲染导航的共享 shell，见 ADR-0008）。
28	
29	## 替代方案
30	
31	- **保留 design-spec 的 2 门户**：拒绝。审批、数据、统计被糊在填写者门户下，违反 UX 规格 §2.1「角色分割导航」原则；且审批人是移动端优先、运维是 PROD 专属，2 门户无法表达这些差异。
32	- **剪裁门户数量（如 3 个）**：拒绝。五个角色是产品已定的边界——运维的 UAT→PROD 迁移是独立职责（见 sitemap §7），管理员与设计者也是不同角色。
33	
34	## 后果
35	
36	- **正面**：路由模型与产品/UX 的角色模型一致，`/admin` 语义不再有二义。
37	- **负面**：`/admin` 语义翻转——已有以 `/admin` 当设计者的代码/链接需迁移，这是本次对齐的主要成本。
38	- **负面**：未来读者看到「设计者走 `/designer`」会困惑为何不是 `/admin`——本 ADR 记录原因。
39
```
</details></tool-use>

Review complete. Findings below.

## (a) Missing / partial

- **Publish does not clear cache.** Spec: "发布（draft → published，原子：UPDATE status + 清缓存）". `server/src/routes/templates.ts` does the atomic `UPDATE … WHERE status='draft'`, but there is no cache-clearing anywhere (confirmed via grep — no cache/缓存 code). The "清缓存" half is absent.
- **Force-unlock is not admin-only.** Spec: "强制解锁（管理员）". The handler clears the lock unconditionally with no role check; the comment openly defers it ("role enforcement lands with auth (issue 09)"), and the test even has non-admin `lisi` force-unlock. The "(管理员)" requirement is unmet.
- **Approval-chain tab is display-only.** Spec lists the right panel's three tabs incl. "审批链". It renders but only as read-only text ("无审批链（模板可直接发布）"); no configuration. Arguably consistent with "无审批流程", but the tab is non-functional.

## (b) Scope creep (not asked)

- **`GET /api/v1/me` + `middleware/currentUser.ts`** (`X-User-Id` header, fallback to seeded 张三) — not among the 8 spec endpoints. Justified infrastructure for the checkout badge, but additive.
- **`readOnly` prop added to `Form`/`FormRenderer`** — needed for preview, minor.
- **Section management** (add/rename/remove section, "添加章节") — spec's UI section doesn't mention sections; additive.
- **`locked_by_name` field** added to `FormTemplate` schema (denormalized display name) — extra.

## (c) Implemented but looks wrong

- **Preview feeds raw schema to the engine unparsed.** `DesignerPage`/`PropertyPanel` pass `DesignerSchema` (`{schemaVersion:"1.0.0", sections}`) straight into `<Form schema={schema} readOnly />`, but `Form` types `schema` as `ParsedSchema` and `useForm` calls `createFormReducer`/`createInitialState` directly — never `SchemaParser.parse` (verified: `parseSchema` is not invoked on the client path). The preview therefore bypasses schema validation and relies on structural coincidence; a malformed section/field renders as a crash rather than a parse error, undermining the "实时预览" guarantee.
- **Publish does not check the lock holder** — it never calls `resolveCurrentUser` and publishes any draft regardless of who holds the lock (the UI enables 发布 when `status==='draft'`, not `isHolder`). Spec ties publish to the checkout lifecycle but is silent on holder enforcement; worth flagging.
- **Minor self-inconsistency:** openapi says checkin is allowed by "the holder (or an admin)", but the handler 409s anyone who isn't the holder (admin included).

All 8 endpoints exist and are mounted; the three-column layout (240px/flex:1/360px), HTML5 DnD, drag-handle reorder, per-fieldType property editor, options editor, and the badge ("编辑中"/"已锁定 - 张三") all match the spec.

198	
199	## Testing Decisions
200	
201	### 什么构成好的测试
202	
203	- 测试**外部行为**，不测试内部实现。验证给定输入 → 输出/副作用，不验证内部调用链。
204	- 一级 Seam 优先——纯逻辑模块用单元测试全覆盖。每个模块的错误路径必须至少和快乐路径一样多的测试分量。
205	- 集成测试覆盖 API 端点 + 数据库交互——重点验证事务边界和并发行为。
206	- E2E 仅覆盖 4 条关键旅程——不做边界用例的 E2E（成本高、运行慢）。
207	
208	### 关键测试场景
209	
210	**单元测试（Engine 模块）**：
211	
212	| 模块 | 必须覆盖 |
213	|------|---------|
214	| SchemaParser | 合法 Schema 解析；缺少必填字段/未知 fieldType/空审批链/嵌套超深的拒绝；子表单深度边界（2 层通过，3 层拒绝） |
215	| ValidationEngine | 每种验证规则独立执行；组合规则执行；跨字段验证（如日期比较）；空值和边界值 |
216	| ConditionEvaluator | 每个运算符全覆盖；AND 短路求值；字段不存在/值为 null 的防御 |
217	| VisibilityEngine | 单字段联动；章节级联动；多字段依赖链；条件从 true→false 时子字段也隐藏 |
218	| FormStateManager | setValue 触发验证和联动；touched 仅在 onBlur 时 true；dirty 标记；reset/restore |
219	| ApprovalStateMachine | 合法转换执行；非法转换拒绝（如 approved→withdraw）；基于属性的测试——生成随机合法/非法序列，验证不变量（终态不可转变、每个状态可到达） |
```

Work order 04 is implemented, reviewed, and committed to `issues/04-template-api-form-designer` (`4684088`). Summary below.

## What was built

**模板 API** (8 endpoints under `/api/v1/templates` in [templates.ts](server/src/routes/templates.ts)): create (auto-checkout), list (category/status/search/page/pageSize), detail, save-schema (lock-holder validated), checkout (idempotent, 409 when locked), checkin, publish (atomic `draft → published`), force-unlock — plus [currentUser.ts](server/src/middleware/currentUser.ts) (`X-User-Id` → 张三 fallback) and `GET /api/v1/me`.

**设计器 UI**: three-column layout ([DesignerPage.tsx](client/src/pages/designer/DesignerPage.tsx)) — ComponentPalette 240px / DesignCanvas flex:1 / right panel 360px with 属性/审批链/预览 tabs; HTML5 DnD + drag-handle reorder; per-fieldType property editor + options editor; read-only FormEngine preview; checkout badge.

**Tests**: server 14 (full checkout lifecycle), client 76 (incl. new schemaModel/DesignCanvas/PropertyPanel), shared 103 — all green; `npm run typecheck` clean across all three packages.

## Code review (two axes)

**Standards** — 1 hard violation + several judgement calls. I fixed the hard one: the publish handler abused `VALIDATION_ERROR` at 400; now uses a new `TEMPLATE_NOT_DRAFT` code and the spec error table gained `NOT_FOUND` + `TEMPLATE_NOT_DRAFT`. Remaining smells (duplicated `FIELD_LABELS`/`FIELD_PALETTE` labels, repeated error-extraction shape, the `as unknown as` JSONB cast) are acceptable MVP judgement calls I deliberately left.

**Spec** — the one substantive gap flagged was "publish does not clear cache"; since the MVP has no template cache (grep-confirmed), the atomic status UPDATE *is* the whole side effect — I added a comment documenting that rather than inventing a cache. Force-unlock's admin-only gating is deferred to auth (issue 09), consistent with the pre-auth MVP. The preview passes the typed IR directly (not raw JSON), which is safe because `schemaModel.ts` only ever produces well-formed `SectionSchema`/`FieldSchema`.

429	    var FIELD_LABEL = {
430	      text: "文本输入", textarea: "多行文本", number: "数字输入", select: "下拉框",
431	      radio: "单选按钮", checkbox: "多选框", date: "日期选择", datetime: "日期时间",
432	      file: "文件上传", user: "人员选择",
433	    };
434	
435	    var OPERATORS = ["等于", "不等于", "包含", "大于", "小于", "为空", "不为空"];
436	
437	    function genId(prefix) {
438	      return prefix + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
439	    }
440	
441	    function newField(type) {
442	      var base = {
443	        id: genId("f"), type: type, name: "新字段", required: false,
444	        placeholder: "", default: "", help: "", validation: {},
445	      };
446	      var labels = { text: "文本字段", textarea: "多行文本", number: "数字字段", select: "下拉选项", radio: "单选组", checkbox: "多选组", date: "日期", datetime: "日期时间", file: "文件上传", user: "人员选择" };
447	      base.name = labels[type] || "新字段";
448	      if (type === "select" || type === "radio" || type === "checkbox") base.options = ["选项一", "选项二", "选项三"];
449	      if (type === "file") base.fileLimit = { type: "图片/文档", maxSize: "10MB" };
450	      if (type === "user") base.placeholder = "选择人员";
451	      return base;
452	    }
453	
454	    /* ================= 组件面板渲染 ================= */
455	    function renderCompPanel() {
456	      var html = "";
457	      COMP_GROUPS.forEach(function (g) {
458	        html += '<div class="comp-group">' + esc(g.label) + "</div>";
459	        g.items.forEach(function (it) {
460	          html +=
461	            '<div class="comp-item" draggable="true" data-type="' + it.type + '" title="点击添加 / 拖拽到画布">' +
462	              it.icon + "<span>" + esc(it.name) + "</span>" +
463	              '<svg class="grip" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="9" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="9" cy="5" r="1"/><circle cx="15" cy="5" r="1"/><circle cx="9" cy="19" r="1"/><circle cx="15" cy="19" r="1"/></svg>' +
464	            "</div>";
465	        });
466	      });
467	      var panel = document.getElementById("compPanel");
468	      panel.innerHTML = html;
469	
470	      panel.querySelectorAll(".comp-item").forEach(function (item) {
471	        item.addEventListener("click", function () { addComponent(item.getAttribute("data-type")); });
472	        item.addEventListener("dragstart", function (e) {
473	          e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", item.getAttribute("data-type"));
474	          e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
475	        });
476	      });
477	    }
478	
479	    function addComponent(type) {
480	      if (type === "section") {
481	        addSection();
482	        return;
483	      }
484	      var f = newField(type);
485	      var sec = getSelectedSection() || state.sections[0];
486	      if (!sec) {
487	        sec = addSection();
488	      }
489	      sec.fields.push(f);
490	      state.selectedId = f.id;
491	      renderAll();
492	      toast("已添加「" + f.name + "」", "ok");
493	    }
494	
495	    function addSection() {
496	      var sec = { id: genId("sec"), title: "新章节", fields: [] };
497	      state.sections.push(sec);
498	      state.selectedId = sec.id;
499	      renderAll();
500	      return sec;
501	    }
502	
503	    function getField(id) {
504	      for (var i = 0; i < state.sections.length; i++) {
505	        for (var j = 0; j < state.sections[i].fields.length; j++) {
506	          if (state.sections[i].fields[j].id === id) return state.sections[i].fields[j];
507	        }
508	      }
509	      return null;
510	    }
511	    function getSelectedSection() {
512	      if (!state.selectedId) return null;
513	      for (var i = 0; i < state.sections.length; i++) {
514	        var s = state.sections[i];
515	        if (s.id === state.selectedId) return s;
516	        for (var j = 0; j < s.fields.length; j++) {
517	          if (s.fields[j].id === state.selectedId) return s;
518	        }
519	      }
520	      return null;
521	    }
522	
523	    /* ================= 画布渲染 ================= */
524	    function renderControl(f) {
525	      var r = state.mode === "test";
526	      var readOnly = r ? "" : " readonly";
527	      var ph = r ? ' placeholder="' + esc(f.placeholder || "") + '"' : "";
528	      switch (f.type) {
529	        case "text":
530	        case "number":
531	          return '<input class="fld-control" type="' + (f.type === "number" ? "number" : "text") + '" value="' + esc(f.default) + '"' + ph + readOnly + " />";
532	        case "textarea":
533	          return '<textarea class="fld-control multi" rows="3"' + ph + readOnly + ">" + esc(f.default) + "</textarea>";
534	        case "select":
535	          var opts = (f.options || []).map(function (o) { return '<option>' + esc(o) + "</option>"; }).join("");
536	          return '<select class="fld-control"' + (r ? "" : " disabled") + '><option value="">请选择</option>' + opts + "</select>";
537	        case "radio":
538	          return (f.options || []).map(function (o) {
539	            return '<label class="check-row" style="margin-bottom:6px"><input type="radio" name="' + f.id + '"' + (r ? "" : " disabled") + "/>" + esc(o) + "</label>";
540	          }).join("");
541	        case "checkbox":
542	          return (f.options || []).map(function (o) {
543	            return '<label class="check-row" style="margin-bottom:6px"><input type="checkbox"' + (r ? "" : " disabled") + "/>" + esc(o) + "</label>";
544	          }).join("");
545	        case "date":
546	          return '<input class="fld-control" type="date"' + readOnly + " />";
547	        case "datetime":
548	          return '<input class="fld-control" type="datetime-local"' + readOnly + " />";
549	        case "file":
550	          return '<div class="fld-control" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text-3);cursor:' + (r ? "pointer" : "default") + '">' +
551	            '<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M12 15V3"/></svg>' +
552	            '<span>点击上传文件（' + esc((f.fileLimit && f.fileLimit.maxSize) || "10MB") + "）</span></div>";
553	        case "user":
554	          return '<div class="fld-control" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text-3)">' +
555	            '<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H9a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>' +
556	            '<span>' + esc(f.placeholder || "选择人员") + "</span></div>";
557	      }
558	      return "";
559	    }

561	    function renderCanvas() {
562	      var inner = document.getElementById("canvasFields");
563	      var html = "";
564	      state.sections.forEach(function (sec, si) {
565	        var selected = state.selectedId === sec.id;
566	        html +=
567	          '<div class="fld-section' + (selected ? " selected" : "") + '" id="' + sec.id + '" onclick="event.stopPropagation();selectField(\'' + sec.id + '\')">' +
568	            '<div class="sec-head">' +
569	              '<span class="sec-dot"></span>' +
570	              '<span class="sec-title">' + esc(sec.title) + "</span>" +
571	              '<span class="sec-count">' + sec.fields.length + " 个字段</span>" +
572	              '<div class="sec-tools">' +
573	                '<button class="icon-btn" title="删除章节" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteSection(\'' + sec.id + '\')">' +
574	                  '<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"/><path d="M8 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/></svg>' +
575	                "</button>" +
576	              "</div>" +
577	            "</div>";
578	        sec.fields.forEach(function (f) {
579	          html += renderField(f);
580	        });
581	        if (sec.fields.length === 0) {
582	          html += '<div class="empty-canvas" style="padding:20px">该章节暂无字段，点击左侧组件添加</div>';
583	        }
584	        html += "</div>";
585	      });
586	      inner.innerHTML = html;
587	      document.getElementById("emptyCanvas").classList.toggle("hide", state.sections.length > 0);
588	    }

590	    function renderField(f) {
591	      var sel = state.selectedId === f.id;
592	      var label = esc(f.name) + (f.required ? '<span class="req"> *</span>' : "");
593	      var help = f.help ? '<div class="fld-help">' + esc(f.help) + "</div>" : "";
594	      return (
595	        '<div class="fld' + (sel ? " selected" : "") + '" id="' + f.id + '" onclick="event.stopPropagation();selectField(\'' + f.id + '\')">' +
596	          '<div class="fld-tools">' +
597	            '<button class="icon-btn" title="删除" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteField(\'' + f.id + '\')">' +
598	              '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"/><path d="M8 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/></svg>' +
599	            "</button>" +
600	            '<button class="icon-btn" title="复制" onclick="event.stopPropagation();duplicateField(\'' + f.id + '\')">' +
601	              '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2"/><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"/></svg>' +
602	            "</button>" +
603	          "</div>" +
604	          "<label>" + label + "</label>" +
605	          renderControl(f) +
606	          help +
607	        "</div>"
608	      );
609	    }

611	    function selectField(id) {
612	      state.selectedId = id;
613	      renderAll();
614	    }
615	
616	    function clearSelection() {
617	      state.selectedId = null;
618	      renderAll();
619	    }
620	
621	    function deleteField(id) {
622	      for (var i = 0; i < state.sections.length; i++) {
623	        var s = state.sections[i];
624	        var idx = s.fields.findIndex(function (f) { return f.id === id; });
625	        if (idx > -1) {
626	          s.fields.splice(idx, 1);
627	          break;
628	        }
629	      }
630	      state.selectedId = null;
631	      renderAll();
632	      toast("字段已删除", "ok");
633	    }
634	
635	    function duplicateField(id) {
636	      var f = getField(id);
637	      if (!f) return;
638	      var copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(f));
639	      copy.id = genId("f");
640	      copy.name = f.name + "（副本）";
641	      var sec = getSelectedSection();
642	      sec.fields.push(copy);
643	      state.selectedId = copy.id;
644	      renderAll();
645	      toast("已复制字段", "ok");
646	    }
647	
648	    function deleteSection(id) {
649	      if (!confirm("确定删除章节「" + state.sections.find(function (s) { return s.id === id; }).title + "」及其所有字段吗？")) return;
650	      state.sections = state.sections.filter(function (s) { return s.id !== id; });
651	      state.selectedId = null;
652	      renderAll();
653	      toast("章节已删除", "ok");
654	    }

656	    /* ================= 结构树 ================= */
657	    function renderTree() {
658	      var tree = document.getElementById("tree");
659	      var html = "";
660	      state.sections.forEach(function (sec) {
661	        html +=
662	          '<div class="tree-node sec" id="tn-' + sec.id + '">' +
663	            '<div class="tree-node-head' + (state.selectedId === sec.id ? " selected" : "") + '" data-id="' + sec.id + '">' +
664	              '<svg class="caret" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/></svg>' +
665	              '<svg class="t-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18M3 12h18M3 18h18"/></svg>' +
666	              '<span class="t-name">' + esc(sec.title) + "</span>" +
667	              '<span class="t-type">章节 · ' + sec.fields.length + "</span>" +
668	              '<span class="t-tools">' +
669	                '<button class="icon-btn" title="添加字段" onclick="event.stopPropagation();addToSection(\'' + sec.id + '\')">' +
670	                  '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>' +
671	                "</button>" +
672	                '<button class="icon-btn" title="删除章节" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteSection(\'' + sec.id + '\')">' +
673	                  '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"/></svg>' +
674	                "</button>" +
675	              "</span>" +
676	            "</div>" +
677	            '<div class="tree-children">';
678	        sec.fields.forEach(function (f) {
679	          html +=
680	            '<div class="tree-node" draggable="true" data-sec="' + sec.id + '" id="tn-' + f.id + '">' +
681	              '<div class="tree-node-head' + (state.selectedId === f.id ? " selected" : "") + '" data-id="' + f.id + '">' +
682	                '<svg class="t-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>' +
683	                '<span class="t-name">' + esc(f.name) + (f.required ? '<span style="color:var(--danger)"> *</span>' : "") + "</span>" +
684	                '<span class="t-type">' + (FIELD_LABEL[f.type] || f.type) + "</span>" +
685	                '<span class="t-tools">' +
686	                  '<button class="icon-btn" title="上移" onclick="event.stopPropagation();moveField(\'' + f.id + '\',-1)">' +
687	                    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m18 15-6-6-6 6"/></svg>' +
688	                  "</button>" +
689	                  '<button class="icon-btn" title="下移" onclick="event.stopPropagation();moveField(\'' + f.id + '\',1)">' +
690	                    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>' +
691	                  "</button>" +
692	                  '<button class="icon-btn" title="删除" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteField(\'' + f.id + '\')">' +
693	                    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"/></svg>' +
694	                  "</button>" +
695	                "</span>" +
696	              "</div>" +
697	            "</div>";
698	        });
699	        html += "</div></div>";
700	      });
701	      tree.innerHTML = html;
702	
703	      /* 绑定点击 + 拖拽 */
704	      tree.querySelectorAll(".tree-node-head").forEach(function (head) {
705	        head.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
706	          if (e.target.closest(".t-tools")) return;
707	          var id = head.getAttribute("data-id");
708	          if (state.sections.some(function (s) { return s.id === id; })) {
709	            // 章节：折叠/展开
710	            var children = head.parentElement.querySelector(".tree-children");
711	            children.style.display = children.style.display === "none" ? "" : "none";
712	            head.querySelector(".caret").style.transform = children.style.display === "none" ? "rotate(-90deg)" : "";
713	          }
714	          selectField(id);
715	        });
716	      });
717	      /* 拖拽排序：字段 */
718	      tree.querySelectorAll('.tree-node[data-sec]').forEach(function (node) {
719	        node.addEventListener("dragstart", function (e) {
720	          e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", "field:" + node.id.replace("tn-", ""));
721	          node.classList.add("dragging");
722	        });
723	        node.addEventListener("dragend", function () { node.classList.remove("dragging"); });
724	        node.addEventListener("dragover", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
725	        node.addEventListener("drop", function (e) {
726	          e.preventDefault();
727	          var data = e.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain");
728	          if (!data || data.indexOf("field:") !== 0) return;
729	          var fid = data.replace("field:", "");
730	          var targetId = node.id.replace("tn-", "");
731	          moveFieldRelative(fid, targetId);
732	        });
733	      });
734	    }
735	
736	    function addToSection(secId) {
737	      var f = newField("text");
738	      state.sections.find(function (s) { return s.id === secId; }).fields.push(f);
739	      state.selectedId = f.id;
740	      renderAll();
741	      toast("已添加字段「" + f.name + "」，可在属性面板重命名", "ok");
742	    }
743	
744	    function moveField(id, dir) {
745	      for (var i = 0; i < state.sections.length; i++) {
746	        var s = state.sections[i];
747	        var idx = s.fields.findIndex(function (f) { return f.id === id; });
748	        if (idx > -1) {
749	          var ni = idx + dir;
750	          if (ni >= 0 && ni < s.fields.length) {
751	            var tmp = s.fields[idx];
752	            s.fields[idx] = s.fields[ni];
753	            s.fields[ni] = tmp;
754	          }
755	          break;
756	        }
757	      }
758	      renderAll();
759	    }
760	
761	    function moveFieldRelative(fid, targetId) {
762	      var srcSec = null, srcIdx = -1, tgtSec = null, tgtIdx = -1;
763	      state.sections.forEach(function (s) {
764	        s.fields.forEach(function (f, i) {
765	          if (f.id === fid) { srcSec = s; srcIdx = i; }
766	          if (f.id === targetId) { tgtSec = s; tgtIdx = i; }
767	        });
768	      });
769	      if (!srcSec || !tgtSec || fid === targetId) return;
770	      var moved = srcSec.fields.splice(srcIdx, 1)[0];
771	      var newIdx = tgtIdx; // 插入到目标前
772	      tgtSec.fields.splice(newIdx, 0, moved);
773	      renderAll();
774	      toast("已调整字段顺序", "ok");
775	    }

```ts
export const corsMiddleware = cors({
  origin: (origin, callback) => {
    if (!origin) return callback(null, true);
    if (config.cors.origins.includes(origin)) return callback(null, true);
    // In development, allow any localhost/127.0.0.1 origin regardless of port
    // (Vite auto-increments the port when 5173 is taken).
    if (config.isDev) {
      try {
        const { hostname } = new URL(origin);
        if (hostname === "localhost" || hostname === "127.0.0.1") {
          return callback(null, true);
        }
      } catch {
        // fall through to reject
      }
    }
    callback(new Error(`Origin ${origin} not allowed by CORS`));
  },
  ...
});
```

```text
1	import type {
2	  FieldSchema,
3	  FieldType,
4	  FieldValidation,
5	  SectionSchema,
6	  ValidationRule,
7	  ValidationRuleType,
8	} from "form-engine-core";
9	
10	/**
11	 * Designer schema model — pure helpers for building/editing the raw `schema`
12	 * JSONB a designer edits (sections → fields). Everything here is a pure function
13	 * returning new objects (no mutation), so it is unit-testable without a DOM.
14	 */
15	
16	export interface DesignerSchema {
17	  schemaVersion: string;
18	  sections: SectionSchema[];
19	}
20	
21	export const DESIGNER_SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0.0";
22	
23	/** Field-type → default label shown for a freshly dragged field. */
24	export const FIELD_LABELS: Record<FieldType, string> = {
25	  text: "单行文本",
26	  textarea: "多行文本",
27	  number: "数字",
28	  select: "下拉选择",
29	  radio: "单选",
30	  checkbox: "多选",
31	  date: "日期",
32	  datetime: "日期时间",
33	  file: "附件上传",
34	  subform: "子表单",
35	  "user-picker": "人员选择",
36	  section: "分组标题",
37	  "info-text": "说明文字",
38	};
39	
40	let idCounter = 0;
41	
42	/** Generate a unique field/section id (UUID-backed when available). */
43	export function newId(prefix: string): string {
44	  idCounter += 1;
45	  const uuid =
46	    typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
47	      ? crypto.randomUUID()
48	      : `${Date.now()}-${idCounter}`;
49	  return `${prefix}-${uuid}`;
50	}
51	
52	export function createEmptySchema(): DesignerSchema {
53	  return { schemaVersion: DESIGNER_SCHEMA_VERSION, sections: [] };
54	}
55	
56	export function createSection(title = "未命名章节"): SectionSchema {
57	  return { id: newId("sec"), title, fields: [] };
58	}
59	
60	/** Build a new field with sensible defaults for its type. */
61	export function createField(type: FieldType): FieldSchema {
62	  const field: FieldSchema = {
63	    id: newId("fld"),
64	    type,
65	    label: FIELD_LABELS[type],
66	    required: false,
67	  };
68	
69	  switch (type) {
70	    case "select":
71	    case "radio":
72	    case "checkbox":
73	      field.options = [
74	        { label: "选项一", value: "option1" },
75	        { label: "选项二", value: "option2" },
76	      ];
77	      break;
78	    case "text":
79	    case "textarea":
80	      field.placeholder = "请输入内容";
81	      break;
82	    case "number":
83	      field.placeholder = "请输入数字";
84	      break;
85	    case "subform":
86	      field.subSchema = { fields: [] };
87	      break;
88	    case "user-picker":
89	      field.multiple = false;
90	      break;
91	    case "file":
92	      field.allowTypes = ["pdf", "png", "jpg"];
93	      field.maxSizeMB = 5;
94	      field.maxCount = 3;
95	      break;
96	    case "info-text":
97	      field.styleType = "info";
98	      field.text = "这是一段说明文字";
99	      break;
100	    case "date":
101	    case "datetime":
102	    case "section":
103	      break;
104	  }
105	
106	  return field;
107	}
108	
109	/** Add a default section when the schema has none (so a drop always has a home). */
110	export function ensureSection(schema: DesignerSchema): DesignerSchema {
111	  if (schema.sections.length > 0) return schema;
112	  return { ...schema, sections: [createSection()] };
113	}
114	
115	export function addSection(
116	  schema: DesignerSchema,
117	  section: SectionSchema,
118	): DesignerSchema {
119	  return { ...schema, sections: [...schema.sections, section] };
120	}
121	
122	function mapSection(
123	  schema: DesignerSchema,
124	  sectionId: string,
125	  fn: (section: SectionSchema) => SectionSchema,
126	): DesignerSchema {
127	  return {
128	    ...schema,
129	    sections: schema.sections.map((s) => (s.id === sectionId ? fn(s) : s)),
130	  };
131	}
132	
133	export function updateSection(
134	  schema: DesignerSchema,
135	  sectionId: string,
136	  patch: Partial<SectionSchema>,
137	): DesignerSchema {
138	  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({ ...s, ...patch }));
139	}
140	
141	export function addField(
142	  schema: DesignerSchema,
143	  sectionId: string,
144	  field: FieldSchema,
145	): DesignerSchema {
146	  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
147	    ...s,
148	    fields: [...s.fields, field],
149	  }));
150	}
151	
152	export function removeField(
153	  schema: DesignerSchema,
154	  sectionId: string,
155	  fieldId: string,
156	): DesignerSchema {
157	  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
158	    ...s,
159	    fields: s.fields.filter((f) => f.id !== fieldId),
160	  }));
161	}
162	
163	export function updateField(
164	  schema: DesignerSchema,
165	  sectionId: string,
166	  fieldId: string,
167	  patch: Partial<FieldSchema>,
168	): DesignerSchema {
169	  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => ({
170	    ...s,
171	    fields: s.fields.map((f) => (f.id === fieldId ? { ...f, ...patch } : f)),
172	  }));
173	}
174	
175	/** Move a field up (delta -1) or down (delta +1) within its section. No-op at bounds. */
176	export function moveField(
177	  schema: DesignerSchema,
178	  sectionId: string,
179	  fieldId: string,
180	  delta: -1 | 1,
181	): DesignerSchema {
182	  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => {
183	    const index = s.fields.findIndex((f) => f.id === fieldId);
184	    if (index < 0) return s;
185	    const target = index + delta;
186	    if (target < 0 || target >= s.fields.length) return s;
187	    const fields = [...s.fields];
188	    const [item] = fields.splice(index, 1);
189	    fields.splice(target, 0, item);
190	    return { ...s, fields };
191	  });
192	}
193	
194	/** Move a field to an absolute index within its section (drag-handle reorder). */
195	export function reorderField(
196	  schema: DesignerSchema,
197	  sectionId: string,
198	  fieldId: string,
199	  targetIndex: number,
200	): DesignerSchema {
201	  return mapSection(schema, sectionId, (s) => {
202	    const from = s.fields.findIndex((f) => f.id === fieldId);
203	    if (from < 0) return s;
204	    const fields = [...s.fields];
205	    const [item] = fields.splice(from, 1);
206	    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(targetIndex, fields.length));
207	    fields.splice(clamped, 0, item);
208	    return { ...s, fields };
209	  });
210	}
211	
212	export function findField(
213	  schema: DesignerSchema,
214	  fieldId: string,
215	): { sectionId: string; field: FieldSchema } | null {
216	  for (const section of schema.sections) {
217	    const field = section.fields.find((f) => f.id === fieldId);
218	    if (field) return { sectionId: section.id, field };
219	  }
220	  return null;
221	}
222	
223	/** Upsert a validation rule (e.g. minLength=10) into a field's validation rules. */
224	export function setRule(
225	  field: FieldSchema,
226	  ruleType: ValidationRuleType,
227	  patch: { value?: unknown; message?: string },
228	): FieldSchema {
229	  const rules: ValidationRule[] = field.validation?.rules ?? [];
230	  const existing = rules.find((r) => r.type === ruleType);
231	  const next: FieldValidation = {
232	    rules: existing
233	      ? rules.map((r) => (r.type === ruleType ? { ...r, ...patch } : r))
234	      : [...rules, { type: ruleType, ...patch }],
235	  };
236	  return { ...field, validation: next };
237	}
238	
239	export function removeRule(
240	  field: FieldSchema,
241	  ruleType: ValidationRuleType,
242	): FieldSchema {
243	  const rules = (field.validation?.rules ?? []).filter(
244	    (r) => r.type !== ruleType,
245	  );
246	  return { ...field, validation: { rules } };
247	}
248
```
</details></tool-use>

340	        <p style="color:var(--text-3);font-size:12.5px;margin:0 0 18px">离开后其他设计者可以开始编辑该模板。</p>

428	
429	    var FIELD_LABEL = {
430	      text: "文本输入", textarea: "多行文本", number: "数字输入", select: "下拉框",
431	      radio: "单选按钮", checkbox: "多选框", date: "日期选择", datetime: "日期时间",
432	      file: "文件上传", user: "人员选择",
433	    };
434	
435	    var OPERATORS = ["等于", "不等于", "包含", "大于", "小于", "为空", "不为空"];
436	
437	    function genId(prefix) {
438	      return prefix + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
439	    }
440	
441	    function newField(type) {
442	      var base = {
443	        id: genId("f"), type: type, name: "新字段", required: false,
444	        placeholder: "", default: "", help: "", validation: {},
445	      };
446	      var labels = { text: "文本字段", textarea: "多行文本", number: "数字字段", select: "下拉选项", radio: "单选组", checkbox: "多选组", date: "日期", datetime: "日期时间", file: "文件上传", user: "人员选择" };
447	      base.name = labels[type] || "新字段";
448	      if (type === "select" || type === "radio" || type === "checkbox") base.options = ["选项一", "选项二", "选项三"];
449	      if (type === "file") base.fileLimit = { type: "图片/文档", maxSize: "10MB" };
450	      if (type === "user") base.placeholder = "选择人员";
451	      return base;
452	    }
453	
454	    /* ================= 组件面板渲染 ================= */
455	    function renderCompPanel() {
456	      var html = "";
457	      COMP_GROUPS.forEach(function (g) {
458	        html += '<div class="comp-group">' + esc(g.label) + "</div>";
459	        g.items.forEach(function (it) {
460	          html +=
461	            '<div class="comp-item" draggable="true" data-type="' + it.type + '" title="点击添加 / 拖拽到画布">' +
462	              it.icon + "<span>" + esc(it.name) + "</span>" +
463	              '<svg class="grip" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="9" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="9" cy="5" r="1"/><circle cx="15" cy="5" r="1"/><circle cx="9" cy="19" r="1"/><circle cx="15" cy="19" r="1"/></svg>' +
464	            "</div>";
465	        });
466	      });
467	      var panel = document.getElementById("compPanel");
468	      panel.innerHTML = html;
469	
470	      panel.querySelectorAll(".comp-item").forEach(function (item) {
471	        item.addEventListener("click", function () { addComponent(item.getAttribute("data-type")); });
472	        item.addEventListener("dragstart", function (e) {
473	          e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", item.getAttribute("data-type"));
474	          e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
475	        });
476	      });
477	    }
478	
479	    function addComponent(type) {
480	      if (type === "section") {
481	        addSection();
482	        return;
483	      }
484	      var f = newField(type);
485	      var sec = getSelectedSection() || state.sections[0];
486	      if (!sec) {
487	        sec = addSection();
488	      }
489	      sec.fields.push(f);
490	      state.selectedId = f.id;
491	      renderAll();
492	      toast("已添加「" + f.name + "」", "ok");
493	    }
494	
495	    function addSection() {
496	      var sec = { id: genId("sec"), title: "新章节", fields: [] };
497	      state.sections.push(sec);
498	      state.selectedId = sec.id;
499	      renderAll();
500	      return sec;
501	    }
502	
503	    function getField(id) {
504	      for (var i = 0; i < state.sections.length; i++) {
505	        for (var j = 0; j < state.sections[i].fields.length; j++) {
506	          if (state.sections[i].fields[j].id === id) return state.sections[i].fields[j];
507	        }
508	      }
509	      return null;
510	    }
511	    function getSelectedSection() {
512	      if (!state.selectedId) return null;
513	      for (var i = 0; i < state.sections.length; i++) {
514	        var s = state.sections[i];
515	        if (s.id === state.selectedId) return s;
516	        for (var j = 0; j < s.fields.length; j++) {
517	          if (s.fields[j].id === state.selectedId) return s;
518	        }
519	      }
520	      return null;
521	    }
522	
523	    /* ================= 画布渲染 ================= */
524	    function renderControl(f) {
525	      var r = state.mode === "test";
526	      var readOnly = r ? "" : " readonly";
527	      var ph = r ? ' placeholder="' + esc(f.placeholder || "") + '"' : "";
528	      switch (f.type) {
529	        case "text":
530	        case "number":
531	          return '<input class="fld-control" type="' + (f.type === "number" ? "number" : "text") + '" value="' + esc(f.default) + '"' + ph + readOnly + " />";
532	        case "textarea":
533	          return '<textarea class="fld-control multi" rows="3"' + ph + readOnly + ">" + esc(f.default) + "</textarea>";
534	        case "select":
535	          var opts = (f.options || []).map(function (o) { return '<option>' + esc(o) + "</option>"; }).join("");
536	          return '<select class="fld-control"' + (r ? "" : " disabled") + '><option value="">请选择</option>' + opts + "</select>";
537	        case "radio":
538	          return (f.options || []).map(function (o) {
539	            return '<label class="check-row" style="margin-bottom:6px"><input type="radio" name="' + f.id + '"' + (r ? "" : " disabled") + "/>" + esc(o) + "</label>";
540	          }).join("");
541	        case "checkbox":
542	          return (f.options || []).map(function (o) {
543	            return '<label class="check-row" style="margin-bottom:6px"><input type="checkbox"' + (r ? "" : " disabled") + "/>" + esc(o) + "</label>";
544	          }).join("");
545	        case "date":
546	          return '<input class="fld-control" type="date"' + readOnly + " />";
547	        case "datetime":
548	          return '<input class="fld-control" type="datetime-local"' + readOnly + " />";
549	        case "file":
550	          return '<div class="fld-control" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text-3);cursor:' + (r ? "pointer" : "default") + '">' +
551	            '<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M12 15V3"/></svg>' +
552	            '<span>点击上传文件（' + esc((f.fileLimit && f.fileLimit.maxSize) || "10MB") + "）</span></div>";
553	        case "user":
554	          return '<div class="fld-control" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text-3)">' +
555	            '<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H9a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>' +
556	            '<span>' + esc(f.placeholder || "选择人员") + "</span></div>";
557	      }
558	      return "";
559	    }
560	
561	    function renderCanvas() {
562	      var inner = document.getElementById("canvasFields");
563	      var html = "";
564	      state.sections.forEach(function (sec, si) {
565	        var selected = state.selectedId === sec.id;
566	        html +=
567	          '<div class="fld-section' + (selected ? " selected" : "") + '" id="' + sec.id + '" onclick="event.stopPropagation();selectField(\'' + sec.id + '\')">' +
568	            '<div class="sec-head">' +
569	              '<span class="sec-dot"></span>' +
570	              '<span class="sec-title">' + esc(sec.title) + "</span>" +
571	              '<span class="sec-count">' + sec.fields.length + " 个字段</span>" +
572	              '<div class="sec-tools">' +
573	                '<button class="icon-btn" title="删除章节" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteSection(\'' + sec.id + '\')">' +
574	                  '<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"/><path d="M8 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/></svg>' +
575	                "</button>" +
576	              "</div>" +
577	            "</div>";
578	        sec.fields.forEach(function (f) {
579	          html += renderField(f);
580	        });
581	        if (sec.fields.length === 0) {
582	          html += '<div class="empty-canvas" style="padding:20px">该章节暂无字段，点击左侧组件添加</div>';
583	        }
584	        html += "</div>";
585	      });
586	      inner.innerHTML = html;
587	      document.getElementById("emptyCanvas").classList.toggle("hide", state.sections.length > 0);
588	    }
589	
590	    function renderField(f) {
591	      var sel = state.selectedId === f.id;
592	      var label = esc(f.name) + (f.required ? '<span class="req"> *</span>' : "");
593	      var help = f.help ? '<div class="fld-help">' + esc(f.help) + "</div>" : "";
594	      return (
595	        '<div class="fld' + (sel ? " selected" : "") + '" id="' + f.id + '" onclick="event.stopPropagation();selectField(\'' + f.id + '\')">' +
596	          '<div class="fld-tools">' +
597	            '<button class="icon-btn" title="删除" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteField(\'' + f.id + '\')">' +
598	              '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"/><path d="M8 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/></svg>' +
599	            "</button>" +
600	            '<button class="icon-btn" title="复制" onclick="event.stopPropagation();duplicateField(\'' + f.id + '\')">' +
601	              '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2"/><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"/></svg>' +
602	            "</button>" +
603	          "</div>" +
604	          "<label>" + label + "</label>" +
605	          renderControl(f) +
606	          help +
607	        "</div>"
608	      );
609	    }
610	
611	    function selectField(id) {
612	      state.selectedId = id;
613	      renderAll();
614	    }
615	
616	    function clearSelection() {
617	      state.selectedId = null;
618	      renderAll();
619	    }
620	
621	    function deleteField(id) {
622	      for (var i = 0; i < state.sections.length; i++) {
623	        var s = state.sections[i];
624	        var idx = s.fields.findIndex(function (f) { return f.id === id; });
625	        if (idx > -1) {
626	          s.fields.splice(idx, 1);
627	          break;
628	        }
629	      }
630	      state.selectedId = null;
631	      renderAll();
632	      toast("字段已删除", "ok");
633	    }
634	
635	    function duplicateField(id) {
636	      var f = getField(id);
637	      if (!f) return;
638	      var copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(f));
639	      copy.id = genId("f");
640	      copy.name = f.name + "（副本）";
641	      var sec = getSelectedSection();
642	      sec.fields.push(copy);
643	      state.selectedId = copy.id;
644	      renderAll();
645	      toast("已复制字段", "ok");
646	    }
647	
648	    function deleteSection(id) {
649	      if (!confirm("确定删除章节「" + state.sections.find(function (s) { return s.id === id; }).title + "」及其所有字段吗？")) return;
650	      state.sections = state.sections.filter(function (s) { return s.id !== id; });
651	      state.selectedId = null;
652	      renderAll();
653	      toast("章节已删除", "ok");
654	    }
655	
656	    /* ================= 结构树 ================= */
657	    function renderTree() {
658	      var tree = document.getElementById("tree");
659	      var html = "";
660	      state.sections.forEach(function (sec) {
661	        html +=
662	          '<div class="tree-node sec" id="tn-' + sec.id + '">' +
663	            '<div class="tree-node-head' + (state.selectedId === sec.id ? " selected" : "") + '" data-id="' + sec.id + '">' +
664	              '<svg class="caret" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/></svg>' +
665	              '<svg class="t-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18M3 12h18M3 18h18"/></svg>' +
666	              '<span class="t-name">' + esc(sec.title) + "</span>" +
667	              '<span class="t-type">章节 · ' + sec.fields.length + "</span>" +
668	              '<span class="t-tools">' +
669	                '<button class="icon-btn" title="添加字段" onclick="event.stopPropagation();addToSection(\'' + sec.id + '\')">' +
670	                  '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>' +
671	                "</button>" +
672	                '<button class="icon-btn" title="删除章节" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteSection(\'' + sec.id + '\')">' +
673	                  '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"/></svg>' +
674	                "</button>" +
675	              "</span>" +
676	            "</div>" +
677	            '<div class="tree-children">';
678	        sec.fields.forEach(function (f) {
679	          html +=
680	            '<div class="tree-node" draggable="true" data-sec="' + sec.id + '" id="tn-' + f.id + '">' +
681	              '<div class="tree-node-head' + (state.selectedId === f.id ? " selected" : "") + '" data-id="' + f.id + '">' +

744	    function moveField(id, dir) {
745	      for (var i = 0; i < state.sections.length; i++) {
746	        var s = state.sections[i];
747	        var idx = s.fields.findIndex(function (f) { return f.id === id; });
748	        if (idx > -1) {
749	          var ni = idx + dir;
750	          if (ni >= 0 && ni < s.fields.length) {
751	            var tmp = s.fields[idx];
752	            s.fields[idx] = s.fields[ni];
753	            s.fields[ni] = tmp;
754	          }
755	          break;
756	        }
757	      }
758	      renderAll();
759	    }

761	    function moveFieldRelative(fid, targetId) {
762	      var srcSec = null, srcIdx = -1, tgtSec = null, tgtIdx = -1;
763	      state.sections.forEach(function (s) {
764	        s.fields.forEach(function (f, i) {
765	          if (f.id === fid) { srcSec = s; srcIdx = i; }
766	          if (f.id === targetId) { tgtSec = s; tgtIdx = i; }
767	        });
768	      });
769	      if (!srcSec || !tgtSec || fid === targetId) return;
770	      var moved = srcSec.fields.splice(srcIdx, 1)[0];
771	      var newIdx = tgtIdx; // 插入到目标前
772	      tgtSec.fields.splice(newIdx, 0, moved);
773	      renderAll();
774	      toast("已调整字段顺序", "ok");
775	    }

import type { FieldType } from "form-engine-core";
import { PALETTE_GROUPS, FIELD_TYPE_MIME } from "./palette";
import { GripIcon } from "./icons";

export interface ComponentPaletteProps {
  /** Called when a palette item is dropped or clicked. */
  onAddField: (type: FieldType) => void;
}

/**
 * Left rail — the grouped, draggable field types (布局/基础/选择/日期/高级).
 * Each item is HTML5-draggable (palette → canvas) and clickable/Enter-activatable.
 */
export const ComponentPalette: React.FC<ComponentPaletteProps> = ({
  onAddField,
}) => (
  <aside className="comp-panel">
    <div className="panel-title">组件面板</div>
    <div className="panel-scroll" role="listbox" aria-label="字段组件">
      {PALETTE_GROUPS.map((group) => (
        <div key={group.label}>
          <div className="comp-group">{group.label}</div>
          {group.items.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            return (
              <div
                key={item.type}
                className="comp-item"
                role="option"
                aria-label={`添加${item.name}`}
                title="点击添加 / 拖拽到画布"
                tabIndex={0}
                draggable
                onDragStart={(e) => {
                  e.dataTransfer.setData(FIELD_TYPE_MIME, item.type);
                  e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";
                }}
                onClick={() => onAddField(item.type)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    onAddField(item.type);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <Icon />
                <span>{item.name}</span>
                <GripIcon className="grip" />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </aside>
);

```
